shows.name: 3 Body Problem
shows.overview: Across continents and decades, five brilliant friends make earth-shattering discoveries as the laws of science unravel and an existential threat emerges.

episodes.name: Countdown
episodes.overview: Unsettling events put a group of brilliant friends on edge as a mystery unravels with origins tracing back to China during the Cultural Revolution.

episodes.name: Red Coast
episodes.overview: Auggie's countdown jeopardizes her nanotech work. Jin becomes engrossed in an otherworldly VR game. Ye Wenjie follows through on a radical idea.

episodes.name: Destroyer of Worlds
episodes.overview: Obsessed with their virtual reality quest, Jin and Jack race to solve a complex riddle — but advancing to the next level brings harrowing consequences.

episodes.name: Our Lord
episodes.overview: Jin seeks justice after a death rattles the group. Investigators learn of an extremist group devoted to an otherworldly entity ahead of a major summit.

episodes.name: Judgment Day
episodes.overview: As threat levels rise, a secret mission to retrieve enemy intel ventures into dangerous territory. An ominous message reaches Earth.

episodes.name: The Stars Our Destination
episodes.overview: With the world in a state of panic following a momentous declaration, Wade gathers the world's greatest minds to prepare a defense plan.

episodes.name: Only Advance
episodes.overview: A bold proposition for the Staircase Project puts the group at odds. Will weighs his options. Ye returns to a familiar place.

episodes.name: Wallfacer

shows.name: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
shows.overview: Set in an age when the Targaryen line still holds the Iron Throne and the memory of the last dragon has not yet passed from living memory, great destinies, powerful foes and dangerous exploits all await these improbable and incomparable friends.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A humble hedge knight and a sharp-tongued boy with a hidden secret roam a restless Westeros, stumbling into honour, danger, and the schemes of powerful lords. As they enter tournaments and cross paths with rising threats, their bond becomes the one thing standing between them and a kingdom on the brink.

shows.name: A Man on the Inside
shows.overview: A retired professor with a knack for snooping gets a new lease on life when a private investigator recruits him to go undercover and crack a case.

episodes.name: Orientation
episodes.overview: When a college president's secrets fall into the wrong hands, Charles poses as a visiting lecturer on campus to sniff out an anonymous blackmailer.

episodes.name: Major Declaration
episodes.overview: While Julie enlists an unlikely expert to dig into new evidence, Charles finds himself on thin ice when his professional and personal lives intersect.

episodes.name: Family Weekend
episodes.overview: A briefing with Brad turns into a chaotic brainstorming session. Emily gets called in as backup when her dad has lingering doubts about Mona.

episodes.name: Spirit Week
episodes.overview: The blackmailer's pressure escalates, a new suspect emerges and a cherished school tradition forces Charles to navigate a glittering gauntlet.

episodes.name: Thanksgiving Break
episodes.overview: The Nieuwendyks' Thanksgiving dinner comes with a side of commotion as an overstuffed table and a pie-related crisis test everyone's holiday spirit.

episodes.name: Extracurriculars

episodes.name: Final Exams

shows.name: Abbott Elementary
shows.overview: In this workplace comedy, a group of dedicated, passionate teachers — and a slightly tone-deaf principal — are brought together in a Philadelphia public school where, despite the odds stacked against them, they are determined to help their students succeed in life. episodes.name: Team Building
episodes.overview: The teachers prepare for the upcoming school year with new faces and big changes on the horizon.

episodes.name: Cheating
episodes.overview: Melissa tries to outsmart her students; Tariq causes chaos in Janine's class; a new guidance counselor joins the school.

episodes.name: Ballgame
episodes.overview: The Abbott crew heads to the ballpark for Teachers' Appreciation Night at the Philadelphia Phillies game.

episodes.name: Game Night
episodes.overview: Gregory steps in to host game night at his apartment. Mr. Johnson, Ava, Barbara and Melissa head to the DMV to renew their licenses.

episodes.name: Camping
episodes.overview: Barbara organizes a Halloween camping trip for older kids.

episodes.name: No Phones
episodes.overview: Abbott Elementary participates in the district’s "No Phones Day" initiative.

episodes.name: Goofgirl
episodes.overview: A new member joins Gregory's Garden Goofballs, and Janine pitches a new club idea to Ava.

episodes.name: Birthday
episodes.overview: Jacob takes the lead on organizing Abbott's annual winter show, and Janine celebrates her 30th birthday.

shows.name: Ahsoka
shows.overview: Former Jedi Knight Ahsoka Tano investigates an emerging threat to a vulnerable galaxy.

seasons.overview: Ahsoka Tano, the former Padawan of Anakin Skywalker during the Clone Wars, investigates a mysterious new threat to the galaxy after the fall of the Empire. As she reunites with her former apprentice, Sabine Wren, rumors of the villainous Thrawn's return are on the rise.

episodes.name: Part One: Master and Apprentice
episodes.overview: A valuable prisoner escapes New Republic custody; a search for answers reunites two old friends.

episodes.name: Part Two: Toil and Trouble
episodes.overview: Ahsoka and General Hera Syndulla travel to New Republic shipyards and make an unexpected discovery.

episodes.name: Part Three: Time to Fly
episodes.overview: Hera tangles with New Republic politics while Ahsoka and Sabine Wren voyage to a distant planet.

episodes.name: Part Four: Fallen Jedi
episodes.overview: Hera risks her career to help her friends while Ahsoka and Sabine confront enemies.

episodes.name: Part Five: Shadow Warrior
episodes.overview: Ahsoka confronts her past, while Hera and her allies undertake a rescue mission.

episodes.name: Part Six: Far, Far Away
episodes.overview: The search for Grand Admiral Thrawn reaches beyond the limits of the galaxy.

episodes.name: Part Seven: Dreams and Madness
episodes.overview: Hera must answer to the New Republic, while far, far away, a reunion takes place.

episodes.name: Part Eight: The Jedi, the Witch, and the Warlord
episodes.overview: The heroes race to prevent Grand Admiral Thrawn's escape.

shows.name: American Horror Story
shows.overview: An anthology horror drama series centering on different characters and locations, including a house with a murderous past, an asylum, a witch coven, a freak show, a hotel, a farmhouse in Roanoke, a cult, the apocalypse and a summer camp.

seasons.name: Murder House
seasons.overview: When the Harmon family relocates to a stately mansion in Los Angeles, disturbing secrets start enveloping each of their lives. As they slowly learn about the mysterious and deadly history of their new house, psychiatrist Ben, Vivien and their teenage daughter Violet find themselves surrounded by all manner of menacing spirits, living and dead.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: A therapist and his family move across the country to escape their troubled past but quickly discover that their new home comes with its own horrific baggage.

episodes.name: Home Invasion
episodes.overview: Vivien and Violet get themselves caught in a dangerous situation. Meanwhile, Ben goes back to Boston to fix a mistake that he made.

episodes.name: Murder House
episodes.overview: Vivien learns the horrific truth about the house's first residents and Ben's visitor causes him to further unravel about what really happened in the haunted house. Constance and Moira have their history revealed.

episodes.name: Halloween (1)
episodes.overview: The line between the living and the dead blurs on Halloween. Two of the house's previous residents give the Harmons decorating advice.

episodes.name: Halloween (2)
episodes.overview: Tate comes face to face with his past, and Ben and Vivien are haunted by a new houseguest before Halloween night comes to an end.

episodes.name: Piggy, Piggy
episodes.overview: Constance enlists Violet's assistance with Tate. Ben helps a new patient confront his fears.

episodes.name: Open House
episodes.overview: Moira persuades a buyer to make an offer while Constance and Larry work against her efforts.

episodes.name: Rubber Man
episodes.overview: The man in the rubber suit is revealed.

episodes.name: Spooky Little Girl
episodes.overview: One of history's most famous murder victims pays the house a visit. Constance discovers more of Tate's bad behavior.

episodes.name: Smoldering Children
episodes.overview: Violet learns about the rules of the house. The truth about Larry's condition is explained. Constance is interrogated by the police.

episodes.name: Birth
episodes.overview: Vivien gives birth. Tate and Violet attempt to rid the house of some of its ghosts for good.

episodes.name: Afterbirth
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of family tragedy, Ben tries to take his child out of the Murder House. Meanwhile, Violet and Vivien accustom themselves to their new living arrangements, Constance raises Tate's child as her own and a new family buys the house.

seasons.name: Asylum
seasons.overview: From Nazis and serial killers to mutants and aliens, no one is safe inside the walls of the Briarcliff Mental Institution. In a house of healing that is anything but, troubled nun Sister Jude rules with an iron fist and Dr Arden conducts strange experiments on the facility’s patients.

episodes.name: Welcome to Briarcliff
episodes.overview: Terrifying evils blur the boundaries between reality and insanity at the Briarcliff Manor.

episodes.name: Tricks and Treats
episodes.overview: An exorcist is called to Briarcliff to help save a troubled farm boy; Sister Jude's darkest secret is revealed.

episodes.name: Nor'easter
episodes.overview: A violent storm allows a group of patients to plan a daring escape; Sister Jude is haunted by her past.

episodes.name: I Am Anne Frank (1)
episodes.overview: A new patient exposes Arden's past; Kit learns why Grace was admitted to Briarcliff.

episodes.name: I Am Anne Frank (2)
episodes.overview: Sister Jude employs a renowned Nazi hunter to gather evidence against Arden; Kit makes a surprising confession; Bloody Face is unmasked.

episodes.name: The Origins of Monstrosity
episodes.overview: A mysterious little girl is abandoned at Briarcliff; the Monsignor makes a Faustian pact with Dr. Arden; the origin of Bloody Face is revealed.

episodes.name: Dark Cousin
episodes.overview: Sister Mary Eunice is terrified to discover a dark angel at Briarcliff; Kit makes a bold move to be reunited with Grace.

episodes.name: Unholy Night
episodes.overview: A murderous Santa wreaks havoc on Briarcliff; Sister Jude faces off with the devil; Arden has a shocking encounter in the death chute.

episodes.name: The Coat Hanger
episodes.overview: The Monsignor takes an unlikely convert under his wing; Lana secures a new piece of evidence that can exonerate Kit; Dr. Arden witnesses a miraculous return.

episodes.name: The Name Game
episodes.overview: The Monsignor confronts the Devil. Dr. Arden’s experiments reach a shocking conclusion. Dr. Thredson facilitates a surprising reunion for Kit.

episodes.name: Spilt Milk
episodes.overview: Grace tells Kit devastating news about the aliens' experiments on Alma; Dr. Thredson receives an unexpected visitor; the Monsignor goes to extreme lengths to silence Jude.

episodes.name: Continuum
episodes.overview: A deadly new inmate threatens Sister Jude's chance of release; Grace's obsession with the aliens turns violent.

episodes.name: Madness Ends
episodes.overview: Johnny sets out to complete his father's work; Lana leads the charge to finally shut down Briarcliff.

seasons.name: Coven
seasons.overview: The few remaining Salem descendants are under assault by forces of ignorance and hate. The young witches seek refuge at Miss Robichaux's Academy in New Orleans, including new arrival, Zoe, who harbors a terrifying secret of her own. Fiona, a Supreme Witch with unimaginable powers, is determined to protect the Coven, but her obsessive quest for immortality will lead her to cross paths with a voodoo queen and a murderous slave owner cursed with eternal life.

episodes.name: Bitchcraft
episodes.overview: A young girl discovers she possesses a strange genetic affliction tracing back to the dark days of Salem; Fiona Goode returns to town.

episodes.name: Boy Parts
episodes.overview: Fiona helps Zoe and Madison deal with a horrible tragedy; Delphine LaLaurie struggles to adjust to modern life; Cordelia faces a dark decision about her family.

episodes.name: The Replacements
episodes.overview: Fiona takes on an unlikely protégé; a guilt-ridden Zoe tries to give Kyle his old life back; Madison has a fiery exchange with Joan Ramsey.

episodes.name: Fearful Pranks Ensue
episodes.overview: Fiona's choices rattle a decades-long truce between the Salem witches and Marie Laveau; the Council of Witchcraft pays a surprise visit to the academy with disturbing allegations.

episodes.name: Burn, Witch. Burn!
episodes.overview: Besieged by Marie Laveau's army, Zoe unleashes a new power; Fiona and Myrtle clash over control of the coven; Madame LaLaurie is confronted by old ghosts.

episodes.name: The Axeman Cometh

episodes.name: The Dead

episodes.overview: Cordelia’s attacker is revealed. Fiona looks to form an alliance with Marie Laveau. Nan learns a disturbing truth about Luke’s past.

episodes.name: The Magical Delights of Stevie Nicks
episodes.overview: Fiona attempts to out the new supreme with a visit from Stevie Nicks; Cordelia learns the truth about Hank and the witch hunters; Madison tries to eliminate her competition for the supremacy.

episodes.name: Protect the Coven
episodes.overview: Fiona and Laveau have a deadly face off with The Corporation; Cordelia makes a desperate sacrifice.

episodes.name: Go to Hell
episodes.overview: Cordelia's latest vision puts the coven's future in question; the girls manifest powerful new gifts; Queenie's search for Marie Laveau leads her to hell and back.

episodes.name: The Seven Wonders
episodes.overview: A new Supreme rises.

seasons.name: Freak Show
seasons.overview: In 1952, in the quiet, sleepy hamlet of Jupiter, Florida, a troupe of human "curiosities" has just arrived in town, coinciding with the strange emergence of a dark entity that savagely threatens the lives of townsfolk and freaks alike.

episodes.name: Monsters Among Us
episodes.overview: One of the only surviving sideshows in the country struggles to stay in business during the dawning era of television; police make a terrifying discovery at a local farmhouse.

episodes.name: Massacres and Matinees
episodes.overview: A citywide curfew threatens to shut down the freak show; a strongman from Ethel's troubled past arrives at camp; Gloria arranges a terrifying play date for Dandy; the Tattler Twins reveal a talent that could knock Elsa from the spotlight.

episodes.name: Edward Mordrake (1)

episodes.overview: Elsa unveils a dangerous new act. Stanley puts pressure on Maggie to murder Jimmy. Paul indulges in a secret romance.

episodes.name: Test of Strength
episodes.overview: The women of the Freak Show rally against Dell after his latest act of violence. A strange encounter with Dandy raises Jimmy’s suspicion about the clown murders.

episodes.name: Blood Bath
episodes.overview: Recent disappearances around camp raise Ethel’s suspicion of Elsa. Gloria makes a last ditch effort to contain Dandy’s bloodlust.

episodes.name: Tupperware Party Massacre
episodes.overview: In the wake of a tragic loss, Jimmy sinks into a drunken despair. A reading from Maggie spurs Dandy to action. Stanley and Elsa track down the Twins.

episodes.name: Orphans
episodes.overview: The death of a Freak sparks troubling behavior in Pepper. Elsa reveals the history of the Freak Show. Desiree grows suspicious of Maggie.

episodes.name: Magical Thinking
episodes.overview: Elsa prepares for her move to Hollywood. The Twins grow enamored with a traveling salesman. Dell plots Jimmy’s escape from police custody.

episodes.name: Show Stoppers
episodes.overview: Dandy gives the Twins troubling information about Chester. Maggie vows to prove her loyalty to Jimmy. The Freaks enforce their harsh code of justice.

episodes.name: Curtain Call
episodes.overview: The Freaks rebel against new management. Dandy prepares for his debut performance. Elsa arrives in Tinseltown.

seasons.name: Hotel
seasons.overview: Homicide detective John Lowe traces a series of grisly murders back to the stylish Hotel Cortez in Downtown Los Angeles and its infamous residents.

episodes.overview: Detective and family man John Lowe investigates a chain of gruesome murders in Los Angeles. A mysterious tip points him to the enigmatic Hotel Cortez.

episodes.overview: Fashion mogul Will Drake brings couture to the Hotel Cortez. A model catches The Countess's eye. John learns about the hotel's sadistic first owner.

episodes.name: Mommy
episodes.overview: Alex is pushed to her breaking point after Scarlett stirs up memories of Holden. Donovan is targeted by a dangerous rival of The Countess.

episodes.name: Devil's Night
episodes.overview: John receives an invitation to attend an exclusive Devil's Night Soiree. Alex tries to diagnose Holden's strange condition.

episodes.name: Room Service
episodes.overview: Alex uses an unconventional treatment to save a dying patient. A Halloween-hating couple tests Iris’s limits.

episodes.name: Room 33
episodes.overview: Ramona and Donovan enact their plan for revenge. Liz Taylor finds true love. The resident of Room 33 is revealed.

episodes.name: Flicker
episodes.overview: Will Drake’s renovations uncover one of the Hotel’s greatest secrets. John undergoes psychiatric evaluation. The Countess learns the fate of her first love.

episodes.name: The Ten Commandments Killer
episodes.overview: John closes in on The Ten Commandments Killer. Sally’s arrangement with March is revealed.

episodes.name: She Wants Revenge
episodes.overview: The Countess is reunited with her one true love. Donovan and Ramona take another stab at revenge. A careless decision lands Alex in hot water.

episodes.name: She Gets Revenge
episodes.overview: Alex enlists John's help to contain an outbreak. Donovan learns the Countess' true intentions. Liz and Iris plan to leave the hotel for good.

episodes.name: Be Our Guest
episodes.overview: Iris and Liz oversee a new era at the Cortez. John and Alex struggle to adapt to life outside the hotel.

seasons.name: Roanoke
seasons.overview: After a disturbing incident, a young couple move into a seemingly perfect home built in the 18th century. However, the building's proximity to the site of the Lost Colony's disappearance and with horrific events happening at the house the couple start to sense something dark underneath the façade.

episodes.overview: Nightmares become an inescapable reality as unique stories of people's lives in America reveal the astonishing power of the supernatural.

episodes.name: Chapter 10
episodes.overview: Lee Harris, the lone survivor of Return to Roanoke: Three Days in Hell, agrees to an interview live on television, the Lana Winters Special.

seasons.name: Cult
seasons.overview: Set just after the 2016 U.S. presidential election, the seventh installment follows a community torn apart by a dangerous cult leader who uses fear as a weapon.

episodes.name: Election Night
episodes.overview: After Trump is elected President, Ally Mayfair-Richards is beset by all of her old phobias... and they appear to be coming to life.

episodes.name: Don't Be Afraid of the Dark
episodes.overview: Ally, Ivy and Oz meet the new neighbors. Kai runs for city council. Detective Samuels investigates a murder. A blackout terrorizes Ally.

episodes.name: Neighbors from Hell
episodes.overview: The community turns on Ally after she shoots and kills a Hispanic man. At home tensions between Ally and Ivy grow worse, and Kai may be Ally's only hope.
Kai gathers familiar faces to join his cult as the events surrounding 11/8/17 are explored.

episodes.name: Holes
episodes.overview: Kai asks for the cult members to prove their loyalty against one of their own. Meanwhile, Ally meets with Rudy to tell him about her problems dealing with Ivy's departure.

episodes.name: Mid-Western Assassin

episodes.name: Great Again
episodes.overview: Kai sets his master plan into motion as Ally's true intentions are revealed.

On the American West Coast, Ms. Wilhemina Venable and Ms. Miriam Mead run Outpost Three with an iron fist. The unexpected arrival of Michael Langdon, a Cooperative representative determined to save society with a secret paradise, throws their order into chaos. However, underneath the surface of humanity’s salvation lies a battlefield for the final conflict between good and evil.

episodes.name: The End
episodes.overview: The end of the world happens when the bombs drop, and the survivors wonder if surviving is worth it after the Cooperative gives them shelter.

episodes.name: The Morning After
episodes.overview: A new occupant arrives at the Outpost with alarming news, causing a domino effect of lust, betrayal and self-destruction.

episodes.name: Forbidden Fruit
episodes.overview: As Ms. Mead grapples with her identity, Michael reveals more of his; Coco's ex rears his ugly head; Venable crafts a plan to give the residents of Outpost 3 one magical night.

episodes.name: Could It Be... Satan?
episodes.overview: Michael's history as a teenager, and how he came to find himself at the Hawthorne Boy's school, is revealed.

episodes.name: Boy Wonder

episodes.name: Return to Murder House

episodes.overview: Darkness descends upon the camp. Although it’s lights out, evil has no curfew.

episodes.name: Slashdance
episodes.overview: Imitation is the best form of tragedy. Coming clean can be pretty messy.

episodes.name: True Killers

episodes.name: Red Dawn
episodes.overview: As twilight broaches, the survivors brace for a final brawl.

episodes.name: Episode 100

episodes.name: The Lady in White
episodes.overview: A hidden chapter of Camp Redwood is revealed. The survivors help a stranded hitchhiker.

episodes.name: Rest in Pieces
episodes.overview: A deadly trio emerges, hell-bent on unleashing a new era at Camp Redwood. Our former counselors desperately try to keep history from repeating itself.

episodes.name: Final Girl

seasons.overview: After leaving her legal career for a new investigative role, Elsbeth finds herself jockeying with NYPD Captain C.W. Wagner as an outside observer for the U.S. Department of Justice in the wake of misconduct findings. Working alongside Elsbeth is Officer Kaya Blanke, who has orders from Wagner to marginalize the attorney's impact on police operations.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: When a college theater student is mysteriously found dead in her high-rise New York City apartment, Elsbeth immediately suspects foul play and enters a game of wits against the victim's popular theater director Alex Modarian.

episodes.name: A Classic New York Character
episodes.overview: After the loathed co-op board president of a luxury pre-war building falls off her balcony to her death, Elsbeth and Kaya are called to the scene to dig for a lead when they meet Joann, a high-powered Manhattan real estate broker with huge clients and even bigger secrets.

episodes.name: Reality Shock
episodes.overview: When a larger-than-life reality TV star is found dead in her bathtub, Elsbeth and Kaya investigate the circumstances around her death to determine if it was an accident or murder. As they get deeper into the events surrounding her demise, they meet Skip Mason, the mercurial producer behind the popular, guilty-pleasure reality series "Lavish Ladies," who becomes a prime suspect after he is accused of going to dangerous lengths to concoct "good TV."

episodes.name: Love Knocked Off
episodes.overview: Things turn deadly when elite matchmaker Margo Clarke goes to extreme lengths to keep her socialite client from finding out the truth about her perfect new husband. When the husband goes missing, Captain Wagner assigns Elsbeth and Kaya to investigate.

episodes.name: Ball Girl
episodes.overview: When the world's top tennis champion drops dead on the court, Elsbeth and Kaya hone in on a rising tennis star and his competitive father and coach. Meanwhile, Captain Wagner begins to suspect Elsbeth's reason for being in New York goes beyond the consent decree.

episodes.name: An Ear for an Ear
episodes.overview: After one of New York's most sought-after plastic surgeons is found dead, Elsbeth has her eye on the victim's former boss, Dr. Vanessa Holmes, who she believes has motives that are more than skin-deep. Also, Kaya keeps tabs on Elsbeth's whereabouts as her investigation into Captain Wagner heats up.

episodes.name: Something Blue
episodes.overview: Elsbeth suspects foul play after a posh country club wedding meticulously planned by an esteemed, but shady, financial advisor, Ashton Hayes, ends in the golf cart death of the hapless groom. Also, Elsbeth plans a housewarming party with some old friends.

episodes.name: Artificial Genius
episodes.overview: Elsbeth goes to battle with artificial intelligence when Quinn, the young CEO of a location-based crime alert app, murders a journalist and uses her app to divert authorities and create a phony killer. Meanwhile, Wagner hatches a plan to fight the D.O.J. investigation.

episodes.name: Sweet Justice
episodes.overview: After hearing his favorite patron talk about being bullied mercilessly in college, the charismatic owner of an exclusive cocktail bar decides to seek revenge on her behalf, but his desire for justice leads to a deadly mistake, leaving Elsbeth and Kaya to connect the dots. Meanwhile, after learning that the DOJ investigation is close to an indictment, Elsbeth and Captain Wagner join forces to expose the real criminal.

episodes.name: A Fitting Finale
episodes.overview: When an unlikable fashion photographer is murdered in the middle of a fashion show, Elsbeth and the team suspect the killer to be either the photographer's college ex - and leading model of the show, Nadine or her jealous husband.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Now embedded in the rhythms of NYPD life, Elsbeth balances case-solving brilliance with behind-the-scenes curiosity. As she peels back layers of departmental politics, she quietly follows her own investigation — one that reaches beyond the cases she’s assigned. With each quirky insight and inconvenient truth, her reputation grows… and so does the list of people who wish she’d go away.

episodes.name: Subscription to Murder
episodes.overview: When a womanizing finance executive is found stabbed to death after a night at the opera, Elsbeth suspects an obsessed opera lover was driven to murder because of a ringing cell phone. Meanwhile, Elsbeth, Captain Wagner and Kaya must adjust to changes in the precinct as the consequences of Noonan's wrongdoing continue to loom.

episodes.name: The Wrong Stuff
episodes.overview: When a billionaire dies in an accident during a space training simulation, Elsbeth suspects a fellow magnate and wannabe astronaut named Neal is responsible. Elsbeth's day is turned upside down when she is reunited with a former colleague.

episodes.name: Devil's Night
episodes.overview: When a former child star turned party girl Mac wakes up on Halloween after a wild night on the town with no recollection of her whereabouts and afraid she may have committed murder, Elsbeth and the team retrace her steps to find the truth. Meanwhile, Captain Wagner must address low morale at the precinct.

episodes.name: Diamonds Are for Elsbeth
episodes.overview: While investigating the death of an employee at New York's most exclusive jewelry store, Elsbeth and the team uncover plans for a gala heist orchestrated by a chic VIP customer.

episodes.name: Elsbeth Flips the Bird
episodes.overview: Elsbeth investigates the death of a devious kitchen staffer after he causes havoc in New York's hottest restaurant and enrages one of America's most revered chefs.

episodes.name: Gold, Frankincense, and Murder
episodes.overview: Celebrity Christmas curators Dirk and DeeDee Dashers go from tinsel to tragedy after Dirk is killed in a freak accident and Elsbeth begins to suspect his wife is behind the death. Meanwhile, Elsbeth gets a holiday surprise courtesy of Wagner and Kaya.

episodes.name: One Angry Woman
episodes.overview: Elsbeth finally makes it as a true New Yorker when she is summoned to jury duty and lands on a murder trial where she faces off with the unusually difficult Judge Milton Crawford, who will prove a formidable adversary.

episodes.name: Toil and Trouble
episodes.overview: Elsbeth is thrown into the world of television after the showrunner of a long-running police procedural is brutally murdered in his office, and although it appears to be the act of a disgruntled fan, she begins to suspect the show's longtime star Regina Coburn, who yearns for artistic fulfillment. Meanwhile, Judge Crawford continues to be a thorn in Elsbeth's side.

episodes.name: Unalive and Well
episodes.overview: When a young man is found dead in his car, Elsbeth visits the holistic wellness center he'd just left, and begins to suspect its charismatic founder.

episodes.name: Finance Bros
episodes.overview: A murder in the world of finance leads Elsbeth to the company Hepson Capital, where she suspects Peter and Bill Henderson, twins known for their dominance in the hedge fund space.

episodes.name: Tiny Town
episodes.overview: Sparks fly between Elsbeth and a handsome Scottish musician named Angus after he witnesses a murder through a video art installation linking Manhattan with his tiny seaside town. The two join forces to solve the case together from across the pond.

episodes.name: Foiled Again
episodes.overview: While investigating the mysterious death of a college admissions officer, Elsbeth finds herself fencing with Lawrence Grey, an independent educational consultant who promises an Ivy League future to high-paying clients and their painfully average kids. The case also causes Elsbeth and Teddy to question how well she prepared him for the real world.

episodes.name: Tearjerker
episodes.overview: While investigating the death of a wealthy real estate developer, Elsbeth is led to the last person to see him alive, a lifestyle consultant named Chloe who is usually found on the arms of residents of New York City's Billionaires' Row.

episodes.name: Scenes From an Italian Restaurant
episodes.overview: When Elsbeth takes a tour of famous New York crime scenes she is left with nagging questions about a legendary Mafia slaying in Little Italy, and about the owner of the family restaurant where it happened, Pupetta Del Ponte. Also, Judge Crawford's grudge against Elsbeth causes a roadblock in the investigation

episodes.name: I See... Murder
episodes.overview: Elsbeth matches wits with a professional psychic (Tracey Ullman) after the stepson of one of her wealthy clients is found murdered in Central Park. Meanwhile, Kaya’s dreams of becoming a detective may come true.

episodes.name: Hot Tub Crime Machine
episodes.overview: After a man’s suspicious death in a hot tub, Elsbeth consults his wife, Freya (Mary-Louise Parker), a decluttering guru whose less-is-more philosophy and controlling personality appear at odds with her “throuple” relationship.

episodes.name: Four Body Problem
episodes.overview: Elsbeth and Kaya reluctantly join forces with an annoying and chatty young police officer in order to solve a funeral director’s death and find that they make an unexpectedly good team.

episodes.name: I Know What You Did Thirty-Three Summers Ago
episodes.overview: As Judge Milton Crawford inches closer to becoming a federal judge, Elsbeth scours his past to prove he's a murderer before it's too late, but her attempts to take him down put everyone around her in jeopardy. Meanwhile, Teddy considers following in his mother's professional footsteps.

episodes.name: I've Got a Little List
episodes.overview: While investigating what appears to be a random shooting, Elsbeth meets Rod, an entitled playboy working through his bucket list of thrills, which may include murder. In the end, Elsbeth's efforts to catch the killer land her in serious legal trouble.

episodes.name: Ramen Holiday
episodes.overview: When Elsbeth tries to solve a murder, she comes face to face with many familiar suspects.

episodes.name: Yes, and...
episodes.overview: Elsbeth dives into the world of late-night comedy when backstage tensions rise between a talk show host, his head writer, and her on-air sidekick husband.

episodes.name: Doll Day Afternoon
episodes.overview: When a murder investigation at a famous New York toy store spirals into a hostage crisis, Elsbeth must negotiate with Nolan, the hapless ex-con inside. Outside, Captain Wagner clashes with a rival whose reckless tactics could turn the standoff deadly.

episodes.name: Good Grief
episodes.overview: When "grief influencer" Raquel Drabowski's presumed-dead husband makes a miraculous return, their reunion takes a fatal plunge. Meanwhile, Elsbeth's surprise reunion with an old friend could expose a dangerous undercover operation.

episodes.name: Ick, a Bod
episodes.overview: Elsbeth must separate trick from treat in Sleepy Hollow when a rivalry reaches a ghoulish climax on Halloween night after a suburban housewife butts heads with a new neighbor. Meanwhile, Captain Wagner makes a frightening discovery about his daughter.

episodes.name: Poetic Justice
episodes.overview: After a donor's death shakes New York’s nonprofit arts scene, Elsbeth questions the motives of the victim's friend, Gary, the founder of a prominent poetry journal. Also, Elsbeth runs into Marissa, who is following in Eli's footsteps and working as the campaign manager for a mayoral candidate.

episodes.name: Bunker Down
episodes.overview: When a crisis manager vanishes inside a billionaire's panic room, Elsbeth unravels the highly equipped fortresses that blur the lines between security and paranoia. Meanwhile, Elsbeth meets the late Judge Crawford's widow, Winnie.

episodes.name: And Then There Were Nuns
episodes.overview: A pop star's purchase of a failing convent turns divine real estate into a murder scene as Elsbeth takes on the Mother of all nuns. Meanwhile, Teddy digs into Alec Bloom's past for a feature he is working on.

episodes.name: Basket Case
episodes.overview: Elsbeth goes from the squad room to the locker room when a campus murder rocks the world of college basketball after an athletic director winds up dead following a heated confrontation with his basketball coach's 22-year-old girlfriend.

episodes.name: Glamazons
episodes.overview: A fallen '90s supermodel returns to New York for a reunion and revenge, leading Elsbeth to sort through old grudges and lies to catch a killer. Meanwhile, Officer Hackett takes her turn in the spotlight.

episodes.name: A Hard Nut to Crack
episodes.overview: When an avant-garde choreographer's Nutcracker rehearsal turns deadly, Elsbeth leaps into the cutthroat world of New York ballet.

shows.name: English Teacher
shows.overview: A high school teacher in Austin tries to balance the competing demands of the students and their parents in a world where the rules seem to change every day.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season 2, Evan still refuses to stay quiet when controversy arises at Morrison-Hensley High. The gang finds themselves in the crosshairs of issues including climate change, Covid, military recruitment and student phone usage. Evan also struggles to keep his relationship with Malcolm separate from his work life. Even though Malcolm no longer works at Morrison-Hensley, Evan’s excessive righteousness at school takes an increasing toll on his romantic life.

episodes.name: Covid in America
episodes.overview: Evan pushes back against the students as they try to modernize the school play.

episodes.name: Trash
episodes.overview: Evan attempts to update the school's waste management system.

episodes.name: Grant's Dinner Party
episodes.overview: Grant invites the teachers to a dinner party at his home.

episodes.name: College Week
episodes.overview: As the students prepare their college applications, Evan starts to question his own hiring.

episodes.name: Evan's Mom
episodes.overview: Evan receives a surprise visit from his mother Elena.

episodes.name: Recruiter
episodes.overview: A military recruiter comes to the school, and the teachers experiment with new classroom phone policies.

episodes.name: Lake Trip
episodes.overview: Evan and Malcolm take a vacation while the other teachers administer standardized tests back at school.

episodes.name: Accreditation
episodes.overview: The teachers get evaluated by outside observers in an effort to earn the school a better rating.

episodes.name: Lock In
episodes.overview: The teachers oversee the school's overnight lock-in.

episodes.name: Graduation
episodes.overview: The teachers try to prevent a student prank from ruining graduation.

shows.name: Peaky Blinders
shows.overview: A gangster family epic set in 1919 Birmingham, England and centered on a gang who sew razor blades in the peaks of their caps, and their fierce boss Tommy Shelby, who means to move up in the world.
When mysterious events change the course of an immigrant ship headed for New York in 1899, a mind-bending riddle unfolds for its bewildered passengers.

shows.name: Foundation
shows.overview: Follow a band of exiles on their monumental journey to save humanity and rebuild civilization amid the fall of the Galactic Empire.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Follow a band of exiles on their monumental journey to save humanity and rebuild civilization amid the fall of the Galactic Empire.

episodes.name: The Emperor's Peace
episodes.overview: Gaal Dornick leaves her life in Synnax behind when the galaxy's greatest mathematician, Hari Seldon, invites her to Trantor.

episodes.name: Preparing to Live
episodes.overview: The Foundation makes the long journey to Terminus as Gaal and Raych grow closer. The Empire faces a difficult decision.

episodes.name: The Mathematician's Ghost
episodes.overview: Brother Dusk reflects on his legacy as he prepares for ascension. The Foundation arrives on Terminus and finds a mysterious object.

episodes.name: Barbarians at the Gate
episodes.overview: Salvor faces off with an enemy of the Empire. Brothers Day and Dusk are at odds, while Brother Dawn wrestles with his truth.

episodes.name: Upon Awakening
episodes.overview: A flashback reveals the origin of Gaal’s conflict between faith and science. The standoff on Terminus takes an unfortunate turn.

episodes.name: Death and the Maiden
episodes.overview: Brother Day meets Zephyr Halima—a would-be leader who opposes the Empire. Brother Dusk grows suspicious of Brother Dawn.

episodes.name: Mysteries and Martyrs
episodes.overview: The Anacreons and their hostages board the fabled Invictus warship. The bond between Brother Dawn and Azura intesifies.

episodes.name: The Missing Piece
episodes.overview: Brother Day embarks on a journey that no other Cleon has ever attempted. Salvor prepares to make the ultimate sacrifice to return home.

episodes.name: The First Crisis
episodes.overview: On Terminus, Salvor witnesses how powerful the null field has become. Brother Dawn makes a daring choice.

episodes.name: The Leap
episodes.overview: An unexpected ally helps Salvor broker an alliance. A confrontation between the Brothers leads to unthinkable consequences.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: More than a century after the events in the Season 1 finale, tension mounts throughout the galaxy. As the ruling dynasty begins to unravel, a young queen plots her revenge. Meanwhile, a colony of people with special abilities poses a new threat. And it’s all leading toward a collision course for war.

episodes.name: In Seldon's Shadow
episodes.overview: Hari finds himself trapped in a mysterious prison. An assassination attempt leaves Day shaken. Gaal and Salvor devise an escape plan.

episodes.name: A Glimpse of Darkness
episodes.overview: Gaal has a disturbing vision. Day's bond with Queen Sareth grows stronger. The Vault opens and reveals a cryptic message.

episodes.name: King and Commoner
episodes.overview: The Empire recruits Bel Riose to investigate the resurgent Foundation. Hari leads Gaal and Salvor to a desert planet.

episodes.name: Where the Stars Are Scattered Thinly
episodes.overview: Queen Sareth and Dawn share a moment as she tries to learn more about Day. Brothers Constant and Poly bring Hober Mallow to Terminus.

episodes.name: The Sighted and the Seen
episodes.overview: Gaal, Salvor, and Hari arrive on Ignis and meet the source of the strange signal they've been tracking. Dawn and Dusk are suspicious of Day.

episodes.name: Why the Gods Made Wine
episodes.overview: Day and Queen Sareth make an announcement. Tellem sows seeds of distrust between Gaal and Hari. Hober Mallow reaches his destination.

episodes.name: A Necessary Death
episodes.overview: Salvor begins to question the Mentalics' motives. Hober Mallow’s proposal to the Spacers meets resistance. Brothers Constant and Poly stand trial.

episodes.name: The Last Empress
episodes.overview: Enjoiner Rue confides in Dusk about her distrust of Demerzel. Hober Mallow pulls a daring move. Day sets course for Terminus and the Foundation.

episodes.name: Long Ago, Not Far Away
episodes.overview: Dusk and Enjoiner Rue learn Demerzel's origin and true purpose. Tellem's plans for Gaal take a dark turn. On Terminus, Day confronts Dr. Seldon.

episodes.name: Creation Myths
episodes.overview: Gaal, Salvor, and Hari chart a new path forward on Ignis. Demerzel heads to Trantor, taking actions that will change Empire forever.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: 152 years after the events of season two, The Foundation has become increasingly established far beyond its humble beginnings while the Cleonic Dynasty's Empire has dwindled. As both of these galactic powers forge an uneasy alliance, a threat to the entire galaxy appears in the fearsome form of a warlord known as "The Mule," whose sights are set on ruling the universe by use of physical and military force as well as mind control. It’s anyone's guess who will win, who will lose, who will live and who will die as Hari Seldon, Gaal Dornick, the Cleons and Demerzel play a potentially deadly game of intergalactic chess.

episodes.name: A Song for the End of Everything
episodes.overview: A mysterious new pirate with terrifying abilities—known as the Mule—catches the attention of the Foundation and Empire.

episodes.name: Shadows in the Math
episodes.overview: Gaal and Hari advance their plans on Ignis. Empire grapples with an unforeseen prediction. Pritcher enlists help to investigate the Mule.

episodes.name: When a Book Finds You
episodes.overview: An unexpected alliance is formed. Pritcher, Bayta, and Toran come face-to-face with the Mule. Demerzel seeks spiritual guidance.

episodes.name: The Stress of Her Regard
episodes.overview: Demerzel struggles with the paradox of her programming. Pritcher's true loyalties are revealed. Day sets off on a quest for answers.

episodes.name: Where Tyrants Spend Eternity
episodes.overview: Day enters uncharted territory. Dawn and Gaal put their plan in motion. Magnifico's worth becomes clear. Demerzel attempts to restore power.

episodes.name: The Shape of Time
episodes.overview: A long-awaited reunion turns violent. Day looks for Song. On New Terminus, the Vault opens—and the Mule takes aim.

episodes.name: Foundation's End
episodes.overview: Chaos and destruction rain down on New Terminus. Back on Trantor, Dusk and Quent unite to assess the state of the galaxy.

episodes.name: Skin in the Game
episodes.overview: Gaal and the Second Foundation reckon with the fall of New Terminus. Day faces judgment on Mycogen. Dusk's ascension looms.

episodes.name: The Paths That Choose Us
episodes.overview: Gaal confronts the power of the Mule's conversions. Dusk resorts to drastic measures. Demerzel searches for clarity about the future.

episodes.name: The Darkness
episodes.overview: Gaal and the Second Foundation take the fight to the Mule as Empire's legacy suffers a catastrophic blow.

shows.name: FROM
shows.overview: Unravel the mystery of a nightmarish town in middle America that traps all those who enter. As the unwilling residents fight to keep a sense of normalcy and search for a way out, they must also survive the threats of the surrounding forest – including the terrifying creatures that come out when the sun goes down.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Disoriented travelers find themselves trapped in a mysterious town with no exit, where malevolent forces toy with their minds and hunt them by night.

episodes.name: Long Day's Journey Into Night
episodes.overview: The Matthews’ family road trip takes a horrifying turn when they are detoured to a small pastoral town from which they cannot leave. When their family RV crashes, Sheriff Boyd Stevens and other residents rush to save them before the sun goes down.

episodes.name: The Way Things Are Now
episodes.overview: At Colony House, Tabitha and Julie grapple with their new nightmarish reality. Out in the forest, Jim, Boyd and Kristi struggle to treat Ethan’s injuries. Tragedy strikes from an unexpected source as a new threat arises among the residents of the town.

episodes.name: Choosing Day
episodes.overview: The Matthews family must choose which of the two settlements they will join. Meanwhile, Jade comes to terms with his situation and Boyd is faced with an impossible decision that strikes at the very heart of life in the town.

episodes.name: A Rock and a Farway
episodes.overview: Julie finds comfort in her new friends. Jim and Tabitha deal with their struggling marriage. Ethan ventures off into the forest with Victor. Father Khatri urges Boyd to embrace his role as leader. Sara receives another horrifying directive.

episodes.name: Silhouettes
episodes.overview: Jim, Tabitha and Ethan begin asking questions about where they are in the hopes it may lead them home. Ellis and Fatima show Julie the lighter side of life in town. Jade struggles to make sense of their situation. Boyd seeks guidance.

episodes.name: Book 74
episodes.overview: Boyd’s plan to head off into the forest provokes an unexpected response from Kenny. Jade enlists Jim’s help with an experiment. Tabitha makes a chilling discovery that sends her down a unique path searching for answers.

episodes.name: All Good Things
episodes.overview: Father Khatri tells Boyd why he believes Sara may be useful. Jim and Tabitha find comfort in each other. Colony House celebrates the one-year anniversary of Fatima’s arrival with a party that goes terribly wrong.

episodes.name: Broken Windows, Open Doors
episodes.overview: In the wake of another death, Boyd questions his decision to leave. Kenny steps up and embraces his new role. Jim rallies the town around his idea to build a radio tower. Fatima urges Ellis to make amends with his father before it’s too late.

episodes.name: Into the Woods
episodes.overview: Boyd and Sara journey deeper into the forest than Boyd has ever gone, encountering new and terrifying mysteries. Jim’s confidence in the radio tower begins to wane. An unexpected tragedy causes Donna to unravel. Kenny and Kristi share a moment.

episodes.name: Oh, the Places We'll Go
episodes.overview: Boyd draws strength from an unlikely source. Jim’s radio tower yields consequences which rock him to his very core. The hole that Tabitha has been digging leads her somewhere, and to someone, she could never have expected.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Hidden truths about the nature and terrifying origins of the town begin to emerge, even as life for its residents is plunged into chaos by the arrival of mysterious newcomers.

episodes.name: Strangers in a Strange Land
episodes.overview: In Sheriff Boyd’s absence, Donna and Kenny struggle to manage the chaos as a busload of unwitting newcomers arrives in town. Victor and Tabitha go on a chilling journey through the nightmarish labyrinth of tunnels beneath the town.

episodes.name: The Kindness of Strangers
episodes.overview: A tense night in the diner as the residents and newcomers wait for sunrise. Fear permeates the wreckage beneath the Matthews house, as Jim and Tom struggle to keep a panicked bus passenger quiet.

episodes.name: Tether
episodes.overview: Kenny and Ellis make a grisly discovery out in the forest. Boyd struggles with the reality of what’s happening to him.

episodes.name: This Way Gone
episodes.overview: As Boyd’s condition grows more alarming, Sara’s return to town puts him in a difficult position. Jim shares a troubling new theory about the town.

episodes.name: Lullaby
episodes.overview: Sara must face the music, as word of her return spreads through town. Victor and Jade strike an unlikely bargain.

episodes.name: Pas de Deux
episodes.overview: Tensions run high at Colony House when word of the coming food shortage leaks out. A night at the clinic takes a terrifying turn.

episodes.name: Belly of the Beast
episodes.overview: Boyd and Kristi seek to capitalize on the apparent death of the Nightmare Creature. Jim finds an unlikely ally in the volatile Randall.

episodes.name: Forest for the Trees
episodes.overview: In their pursuit of the truth about the town, Jim and Randall hatch a dangerous plan. Meanwhile, a new form of terror is brewing.

episodes.name: Ball of Magic Fire
episodes.overview: Panic spreads through town as the residents face a chilling new threat to their survival. Jim realizes the magnitude of the mistake he made by enlisting Randall in his cause.

episodes.name: Once Upon a Time...
episodes.overview: Boyd fears he may have finally run out of answers, as the residents of town prepare for the end. Tabitha clings to the belief that the children could be the key to their salvation.

episodes.name: Shatter
episodes.overview: Boyd feels the town slipping away from him as the weather grows colder and the residents more desperate.

episodes.name: When We Go
episodes.overview: Boyd struggles to find a path forward as the town bids farewell to one of their own; Fatima's health takes a turn for the worse; Tabitha finds help from an unlikely ally.

episodes.name: Mouse Trap
episodes.overview: Kenny leads a group into the forest in search of food; Donna and Ellis try to talk Boyd out of a dangerous plan; Tabitha makes a mind-bending discovery; Fatima questions the welfare of her unborn baby.

episodes.name: There and Back Again
episodes.overview: Boyd is forced to make a tough decision when newcomers arrive in town at nightfall; Victor unearths memories from the past in the hopes of finding answers.

episodes.name: The Light of Day
episodes.overview: Victor must face a painful reminder of his past; Julie looks for ways to cope with her trauma; Boyd struggles to keep the town safe as the residents begin to question his judgement; Tabitha tries to adjust to her new surroundings.

episodes.name: Scar Tissue
episodes.overview: Fatima and Ellis make a big decision about her pregnancy; Boyd fears for the future of his family; Tensions rise in the Matthews house; Randall opens up to Marielle about his fears.

episodes.name: These Fragile Lives
episodes.overview: The edges begin to fray as concerns about Fatima's pregnancy deepen; Jade follows a clue trail into the forest; Julie and Randall seek a bit of normalcy.

episodes.name: Thresholds
episodes.overview: Accusations start flying and truths come to light in the aftermath of a tragedy; Victor struggles to recover long-buried memories about the town's past; Julie and Ethan search for answers about the mysterious ruins in the woods.

episodes.name: Revelations: Chapter One
episodes.overview: Tensions are at an all time high as the residents of town learn that one of their own has gone missing.

episodes.name: Revelations: Chapter Two
episodes.overview: Boyd is pushed to his limit as time begins to run out for someone he loves; Randall is haunted by his trauma and Victor reveals a hard truth; Tabitha's unlikely journey takes a shocking turn.

shows.name: Ghosts
shows.overview: Samantha and Jay throw caution to the wind when they convert their recently inherited country estate into a bed-and-breakfast. Call it mislaid plans. Not only is the place falling apart, but it’s also inhabited by spirits of previous residents -- whom only Samantha can see and hear.

episodes.name: Soul Custody
episodes.overview: Sam, Jay and the ghosts attempt to extricate Jay from his deal with Elias Woodstone, the devil. Also, Isaac helps Patience through a crisis of confidence and Pete and Alberta navigate the fallout from their kiss.

episodes.name: Viking Wedding
episodes.overview: Sam and Jay try to impress their trendy city friends while a misplaced bookcase threatens Thor's ability to deliver an important speech. Also, Isaac rallies the ghosts to help the couple navigate a tough customer service ordeal.

episodes.name: Halloween 5: The Mummy
episodes.overview: Sam and Jay's Halloween takes a spooky turn when they accidentally unleash a mummy ghost.

episodes.name: Bring Your Daughter to Work Day
episodes.overview: Trevor finds a way to spend more time with his newly discovered daughter, Abby, by getting her at job at Jay's restaurant.

episodes.name: T-Daddy
episodes.overview: Trevor's relationship with his daughter is strained when he pushes her to follow a career in finance over poetry. Meanwhile, Jay confronts labor unrest at the restaurant.

episodes.name: Planes, Shanes, and Automobiles
episodes.overview: Sam and Pete get on each other's nerves during a book tour road trip and things reach a breaking point when an airline strike threatens their ability to get home in time for Thanksgiving.

episodes.name: The Proposal
episodes.overview: Sam helps Eric plan the perfect proposal for Bela, until an encounter with Sasappis plants doubt in Bela's mind. Meanwhile, Isaac tries to prove he's "just one of the basement ghosts".

episodes.name: The Life and Times of Esther Greene
episodes.overview: Now a successful podcaster, Todd Pearlman returns to profile Sam and Isaac's book, but becomes obsessed with Jay. Meanwhile, Pete tries to get to the bottom of why Alberta changed her name, forcing her to admit a hidden truth.

episodes.name: It’s A Wonderful Christmas Carol (1)
episodes.overview: The annual two-part GHOSTMAS episodes, featuring the yearly holiday possession.

episodes.name: It’s A Wonderful Christmas Carol (2)

shows.name: House of the Dragon
shows.overview: The Targaryen dynasty is at the absolute apex of its power, with more than 15 dragons under their yoke. Most empires crumble from such heights. In the case of the Targaryens, their slow fall begins when King Viserys breaks with a century of tradition by naming his daughter Rhaenyra heir to the Iron Throne. But when Viserys later fathers a son, the court is shocked when Rhaenyra retains her status as his heir, and seeds of division sow friction across the realm.

seasons.overview: Set nearly 200 years before Game of Thrones, this season chronicles the events leading up to the Targaryen civil war, known as the Dance of the Dragons. King Viserys I Targaryen names his daughter, Princess Rhaenyra, as heir to the Iron Throne, breaking tradition and igniting tensions within the realm. The court becomes divided as Queen Alicent Hightower, Viserys’s second wife, promotes her son Aegon’s claim to the throne. Political intrigue, shifting alliances, and personal betrayals set the stage for a looming conflict that threatens to tear the Targaryen dynasty apart.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The Dance of the Dragons erupts as Rhaenyra and Aegon II both assert their claims to the Iron Throne, plunging Westeros into a brutal civil war. The season delves into the complexities of loyalty, power, and family as both sides employ dragons and armies to assert dominance. Key events include the tragic assassination of Prince Jaehaerys, escalating the conflict, and the shifting dynamics among key players like Daemon Targaryen and Alicent Hightower. As the war intensifies, the realm witnesses the devastating consequences of ambition and the high cost of succession disputes.

episodes.overview: As ancient grudges resurface, Rhaenys suggests that Alicent may see reason while the men around her seek bloodshed. Ser Criston proposes a bold scheme. Daemon arrives at Harrenhal to raise an army for the Blacks.

episodes.overview: As Rhaenyra looks to gain an advantage by unusual means, Daemon pressures a young liege lord to raise up his bannermen.

episodes.overview: As Aemond becomes more volatile, Larys plots an escape, and Alicent grows more concerned about Helaena's safety. Flush with new power, Rhaenyra looks to press her advantage.
