episodes.overview: The end is in sight for the campmates, but there are still plenty more challenges and surprises in store for the jungle celebrities.

episodes.name: Frightseers
episodes.overview: The competition is getting tougher as the celebrity campmates get closer to one of them being crowned King or Queen of the Jungle.

episodes.name: Pump of Peril
episodes.overview: The competition is getting tougher as the celebrity campmates get closer to one of them being crowned King or Queen of the Jungle.

episodes.name: Celebrity Cyclone
episodes.overview: Soon, one of the celebrity campmates will get their hands on the jungle crown... but who will leave before the grand final?

episodes.name: Stake Out / Bushtucker Bonanza / Panic Pit
episodes.overview: They've survived until the end after enduring Bushtucker Trials, camp life and each other. But which of the finalists will you crown King or Queen of the Jungle?

episodes.name: Coming Out
episodes.overview: Just a few days after the new King or Queen of the jungle was crowned, Ant and Dec present the usual round-up of what happened behind the scenes as each campmate was voted out. From the first to the last, the programme reveals what they get up to in their first few days of freedom, and captures their reactions to old rivals and trusted friends, while their families gather for emotional reunions with their loved ones.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: The jungle is calling… Britain’s biggest reality show is back! A brand new batch of celebrities head Down Under, ready to face their fears and fight for the crown.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: As the new batch of celebrities get used to their new surroundings, they must take on trials and challenges in the hope of winning food for the camp.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: It's time to head back to Australia as the celebrities continue to get to know each other while they settle into camp life.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The celebrities battle it out to win stars for food in the hope of keeping spirits high in the camp.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: The celebrities are starting to settle into camp life and taking on everything that the jungle throws at them - with stars and treats up for grabs, they must battle it out in trials and challenges.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The celebrities are settling into jungle life away from their home comforts, but who can go the distance in the hope of being crowned as King or Queen of the Jungle?

shows.name: IT: Welcome to Derry
shows.overview: In 1962, a couple with their son move to Derry, Maine just as a young boy disappears. With their arrival, very bad things begin to happen in the town.

episodes.name: The Pilot
episodes.overview: As four misfit kids vow to find their missing classmate, Major Leroy Hanlon arrives to a mixed reception at Derry Air Force Base.

episodes.name: The Thing in the Dark
episodes.overview: While Charlotte and Will navigate their new life in Derry, Ronnie worries about her father's fate.

episodes.name: Now You See It
episodes.overview: As Leroy, Pauly, and Dick search for a new dig site, the kids attempt to get visual proof of the phenomena they've been experiencing.

episodes.name: The Great Swirling Apparatus of Our Planet's Function
episodes.overview: As the kids face increasingly terrifying experiences, Charlotte attempts to advocate for Hank, and General Shaw escalates his efforts.

episodes.name: Neibolt Street
episodes.overview: As the military descends on Neibolt Street, the kids head into the sewers with their own objective.

episodes.name: In the Name of the Father
episodes.overview: Dick is plagued by increasingly dark visions. Will faces his parents' disapproval, Marge stands up to the Patty Cakes, and Lilly's behavior grows erratic.

episodes.name: The Black Spot
episodes.overview: A vigilante attack on the Black Spot unleashes long dormant forces. In the aftermath, Dick helps uncover another crucial artifact.

episodes.name: Winter Fire
episodes.overview: As a dense fog engulfs the town – and General Shaw pushes ahead with his mission – the Hanlons, Rose, Dick, and the kids must work together to save Derry.

shows.name: INVINCIBLE
shows.overview: Mark Grayson is a normal teenager except for the fact that his father is the most powerful superhero on the planet. Shortly after his seventeenth birthday, Mark begins to develop powers of his own and enters into his father’s tutelage.

shows.name: Landman
shows.overview: Set in the proverbial boomtowns of West-Texas and a modern-day tale of fortune-seeking in the world of oil rigs, the series is an upstairs/downstairs story of roughnecks and wildcat billionaires that are fueling a boom so big it’s reshaping our climate, our economy and our geopolitics.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: In season two, as oil rises from the earth, so do secrets - and Tommy Norris's breaking point may be closer than he realizes. Facing mounting pressure from M-Tex Oil, Cami Miller, and the shadow of his kin, survival in West Texas isn't noble - it's brutal. And sooner or later something's got to break.

episodes.name: Death and a Sunset
episodes.overview: Tommy navigates a tense landscape as Cami asserts control.

episodes.name: Sins Of The Father
episodes.overview: Cami is blindsided; Tommy warns Cooper about his shady entanglements.

episodes.name: Almost a Home
episodes.overview: Tommy confronts Cami about finances; Cooper's success draws attention.

episodes.name: Dancing Rainbows
episodes.overview: A tragic crash sets off a day of reckoning for the Norris family.

episodes.name: The Pirate Dinner
episodes.overview: Tommy juggles multiple crises; Angela throws a dinner to welcome T.L.

episodes.name: Dark Night of the Soul
episodes.overview: Tommy negotiates a risky offshore drilling deal as tensions rise with Cami.

episodes.name: Forever Is an Instant
episodes.overview: Tommy and Angela's getaway turns chaotic; Cami's plans face scrutiny.

episodes.name: Handsome Touched Me
episodes.overview: Tommy hires help for his father as Cami makes a risky move.

episodes.name: Plans, Tears and Sirens
episodes.overview: Angela rescues Ainsley; Cooper asserts his leadership at a drill site.

episodes.name: Tragedy and Flies
episodes.overview: Amid the chaos, Tommy regroups with Cooper.

shows.name: Loot
shows.overview: After divorcing her husband of 20 years, Molly Novak must figure out what to do with her $87 billion settlement. She decides to reengage with her charitable foundation and reconnect with the real world—finding herself along the way.

episodes.name: Space for Everyone
episodes.overview: Molly and the Wells Foundation team struggle to live up to her promise to donate the entirety of her vast fortune. Arthur has a new lease on life.

episodes.name: Clueless
episodes.overview: As Molly moves forward with the Space for Everyone project, Sofia butts heads with its architect. Howard asks Arthur for financial advice.

episodes.name: Vengeance Falls
episodes.overview: When Nicholas' new play premieres, Molly brings some surprise visitors. Howard suspects Sofia is hiding a secret.

episodes.name: Mr. Congeniality
episodes.overview: Molly attends a meditation retreat. Howard and Arthur audition wrestlers for their new league. Ainsley asks Sofia and Nicholas for wedding help.

episodes.name: Mally's
episodes.overview: Arthur and Molly try to sell her megayacht to a Swedish billionaire. Sofia and rest of the team hit the streets to collect signatures.

episodes.name: Women Who Rule
episodes.overview: It's LA Fashion Week—and Molly is asked to walk the runway. Sofia faces commitment issues with Isaac. Arthur asks Howard for style advice.

episodes.name: Camp Wells
episodes.overview: Molly and Nicholas plan a work retreat for the Wells Foundation crew. Sofia and Howard struggle with the outdoors.

episodes.name: Grace
episodes.overview: Sofia and Molly try to recruit another billionaire for their cause. Nicholas needs Howard's help to prepare for a difficult audition.

episodes.name: Mood Vibrations
episodes.overview: As Space For Everyone becomes a reality, Molly's ex-husband tries to steal the spotlight. Sofia struggles to balance work and her relationship.

episodes.name: We Shouldn't Exist
episodes.overview: While Molly and the Wells Foundation are on the precipice of their greatest success, the team faces big personal decisions.

episodes.name: Bye-Bye Mode
episodes.overview: The Wells Foundation team tracks Molly down on a private island to convince her to return—but they're not alone.

episodes.name: Would Hit
episodes.overview: Molly and Arthur go on their first official date. Sofia's chaotic sister Destiny reenters her life.

episodes.name: Lady Molly
episodes.overview: After Molly is deepfaked, she scrambles to restore her reputation by accepting an award at a charity cricket match in England.

episodes.name: Buona Sera
episodes.overview: At Arthur's urging, Molly decides to make peace with her ex-husband. Howard recruits Nicholas and Ainsley to help him impress Destiny.

episodes.name: Joyride
episodes.overview: Molly uses her vast resources to give Nicholas the perfect day, along the way remembering how they first met.

episodes.name: What's Up with Us
episodes.overview: Arthur invites Molly on a birding trip with his friends. Sofia discovers that Howard and Destiny have started dating.

episodes.name: Billionaire, Beautiful and True
episodes.overview: As Molly struggles with relationship problems, Howard realizes she needs Nicholas. Arthur invites Sofia to join his gaming club.

episodes.name: Mr. Maro Gold
episodes.overview: An extremely attractive offer lands on Molly's doorstep. Howard and Destiny present a business proposal to Sofia.

episodes.name: Slide
episodes.overview: Molly settles into a new relationship. Arthur questions his life choices with Nicholas and Howard.

shows.ref_name: Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair
shows.name: Malcolm in the Middle: Life's Still Unfair
shows.overview: Malcolm and his daughter are drawn into the family's chaos when Hal and Lois demand his presence for their 40th wedding anniversary party.

shows.name: Dexter: New Blood
shows.overview: 10 years after Dexter went missing in the eye of Hurricane Laura, we find him living under an assumed name in the small town of Iron Lake, New York.  Dexter may be embracing his new life, but in the wake of unexpected events in this close-knit community, his Dark Passenger beckons.

shows.name: Naked
shows.overview: Seductive killer or innocent victim? A murder mystery like no other.

shows.name: Nine Perfect Strangers
shows.overview: At a boutique health-and-wellness resort that promises healing and transformation, nine stressed city dwellers try to get on a path to a better way of living. Watching over them during this 10-day retreat is the resort's director, Masha, a woman on a mission to reinvigorate their tired minds and bodies. However, these nine "perfect" strangers have no idea what is about to hit them.

episodes.name: Random Acts of Mayhem
episodes.overview: Promised total transformation, nine very different people arrive at Tranquillum House, a secluded retreat run by the mysterious wellness guru Masha.

episodes.name: The Critical Path
episodes.overview: As healing begins, the guests begin to doubt the retreat's unconventional methods. They came for massages and relaxation, not to face their own mortality.

episodes.name: Earth Day
episodes.overview: Forced to live "off the land" on Earth Day, tension within the group erupts as treatment intensifies and hunger pains set in.

episodes.name: Brave New World
episodes.overview: As the guests learn more about Tranquillum's unique protocols, everyone must decide if they will continue under Masha's care. Meanwhile, Masha is receiving mysterious threats of her own.

episodes.name: Sweet Surrender
episodes.overview: Zoe's birthday celebration reopens old wounds, even as the group begins to grow closer.

episodes.name: Motherlode
episodes.overview: As the protocol escalates, relationships are strengthened, even as the effects of the treatment become more unsettling. Masha reveals her unique treatment goals for the Marconi family.

episodes.name: Wheels on the Bus
episodes.overview: Pressure on Masha intensifies, as she juggles the competing needs of her guests, discord amongst her staff and her absolute commitment to healing the Marconi family.

episodes.name: Ever After
episodes.overview: It’s time for everyone to cross the threshold and face their demons, including Masha. But will they make it to other side?

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Nine new strangers connected in ways they could never imagine are invited by mysterious guru Masha Dmitrichenko to join a transformational wellness retreat in the Austrian Alps. Over the course of a week, she takes them to the brink. Will they make it? Will she? Masha is willing to try anything in the interest of healing everyone involved, including herself.

episodes.name: Zauberwald
episodes.overview: In their search for mind and body reinvigoration, nine people from various walks of life arrive at Zauberwald, an Alpine retreat, where they are greeted by the enigmatic wellness guru, Masha.

episodes.name: The Crabapple Clubhouse
episodes.overview: After a rocky first night, the guests go on a foraging mission around the retreat, but one member of the Zauberwald team has concerns about Masha’s specially invited latecomer.

episodes.name: The Field Trip
episodes.overview: Martin escorts the guests to a museum in a nearby picturesque town – a trip that sees the healing protocol take hold with varying effects.

episodes.name: The Major Lift
episodes.overview: Tina and Wolfie’s relationship is put under strain when the Zauberwald ballroom is set up with musical instruments. Victoria offers to have a girls’ night in with Imogen, but the plan goes awry.

episodes.name: Prague
episodes.overview: Masha takes David on a psychedelic tour of their past together.

episodes.name: The Other Side
episodes.overview: Matteo confronts Victoria about the secret she has been keeping from Imogen, while Peter is shaken by a new revelation.

episodes.name: Mergers and Acquisitions
episodes.overview: Helena's past enters the spotlight as Martin spills the beans about Zauberwald's history and possible future.

episodes.name: Never Change
episodes.overview: The strangers finally realize what has brought them together.

shows.name: North of North
shows.overview: A young Inuk woman wants to build a new future for herself after a spontaneous and extremely public exit from her marriage. It won't be easy in a small Arctic town where everybody knows your business.

episodes.name: Top of the World
episodes.overview: Feeling stuck in her life in her tiny Arctic community, Siaja decides it's time to shake things up during the annual Spring Festival, but her plans are derailed by personal upheavals.

episodes.name: No Freeloading
episodes.overview: Siaja struggles to pick up the pieces and prove herself capable of handling more than just her messy personal life.

episodes.name: Dumpcano
episodes.overview: Siaja’s first day of work goes awry when she accidentally starts a fire at the dump and Alistair and Kuuk visit the community center to discuss Ice Cove's candidacy to host a polar research station.

episodes.name: Joy to the Effing World
episodes.overview: With Kuuk’s help, Siaja forms a plan to shake up Elder’s night by coaxing children to attend, hoping to raise the Elders’ spirits. Meanwhile, Neevee seems to run into Alistair everywhere she goes.

episodes.name: Walrus Dick Baseball
episodes.overview: Ice Cove is shortlisted for the polar research station, so Siaja proposes they host a baseball fundraiser to afford upgrades to the community centre to better their chances. Helen is coerced into a winner-takes-all bet by the rival town’s leader.

episodes.name: Carnivores
episodes.overview: Love is not in the air in Ice Cove as Siaja re-enters the dating world in epic style, Neevee and Alistair reach a turning point, and Kuuk has a surprise visitor.

episodes.name: Lost and Found
episodes.overview: The community comes together for an exhausting multi-day search for Ting. Siaja entrusts Alistair to babysit Bun during the search.

episodes.name: Bad Influences
episodes.overview: Siaja and Helen put the final touches on their pitch for the polar research station, when Helen is pulled away. Siaja uses this opportunity to view the only available apartment in town with Kuuk’s help.

shows.name: Only Murders in the Building
shows.overview: Three strangers share an obsession with true crime and suddenly find themselves wrapped up in one.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: After their beloved doorman, Lester, dies under suspicious circumstances, Charles, Oliver, and Mabel refuse to believe it was an accident. Their investigation plunges them into the shadowy corners of New York and beyond - where the trio uncovers a dangerous web of secrets connecting powerful billionaires, old-school mobsters, and the mysterious residents of the Arconia. The trio discovers a deeper divide between their storied city they thought they knew and the new New York evolving around them - one where the old mob fights to hold on as newer, even more dangerous players emerge.

episodes.name: Nail in the Coffin
episodes.overview: While investigating Lester’s mysterious "accidental" death, the clues lure Charles, Oliver, and Mabel out of Manhattan — and straight into some dangerous new "old" territory.

episodes.name: After You
episodes.overview: A look back at Lester's early days at the Arconia reveals how a young dreamer became a steadfast doorman — sacrificing his future to protect the residents from the building’s secrets.

episodes.name: Rigor
episodes.overview: The trio stumbles upon a crucial piece of evidence... and promptly compromises it. With time running out, they scramble to solve the mystery before the police close in on them.

episodes.name: Dirty Birds
episodes.overview: Snooping goes sideways when three billionaire suspects catch the trio and invite themselves over for an evening at Oliver's.

episodes.name: Tongue Tied
episodes.overview: Thwarted in their investigative podcast plans, Mabel and Oliver look for help from the Arconia support staff — as Charles dines with another suspect and gets caught up in "catching" more than he bargained for.

episodes.name: Flatbush
episodes.overview: The investigation takes Oliver and Loretta back to the streets of his childhood, where buried memories surface and secrets about Lester and Nicky's widows emerge. Mabel and Charles follow leads after a break-in.

episodes.name: Silver Alert
episodes.overview: The mayor warns the trio about the billionaires, sending them to investigate further at a villainous lair upstate — as Oliver boots it in an attempted escape.

episodes.name: Cuckoo Chicks
episodes.overview: Mabel gathers a ragtag group to crash an exclusive ladies night. While trying to save the Arconia from being sold, Charles and Oliver accidentally end up in couples' therapy.

episodes.name: LESTR
episodes.overview: Told through the lens of one annoying robot who may hold the keys to more secrets than anyone realized — the Arconia throws one last party as the residents discover that a killer may still be in their building.

episodes.name: The House Always...
episodes.overview: With the clock ticking, the trio doubles down to bring "new" and "old" forces together to bring down a killer — ending in one explosive showdown and the reveals they've been chasing all season.

shows.name: Outer Banks
shows.overview: A tight-knit group of teens unearths a long-buried secret, setting off a chain of illicit events that takes them on an adventure they'll never forget.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: On an island of haves and have-nots, teen John B enlists his three best friends to hunt for a legendary treasure linked to his father's disappearance.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: After a hurricane, John B, JJ, Pope and Kiara plunge headlong into danger and adventure when they find a mysterious sunken wreck.

episodes.name: The Lucky Compass
episodes.overview: Convinced that the clue found onboard the boat connects to his missing father, John B leads his friends on an increasingly frantic search for answers.

episodes.name: The Forbidden Zone
episodes.overview: As the gang hatches an illicit scheme to get to the bottom of the deep-sea mystery, John B confronts Sarah while Pope jumps at the chance for revenge.

episodes.name: Spy Games
episodes.overview: When John B's supervision-free home life catches up to him, he receives a well-timed assist — and some spiffing up — from the last person he expects.

episodes.name: Midsummers
episodes.overview: John B believes he's made a breakthrough in the hunt for the gold, but his desire to include Sarah in the quest causes friction among the friends.

episodes.name: Parcel 9
episodes.overview: A spooky island legend, a broken friendship and John B’s new living situation keep the crew on their toes as they search high and low for the treasure.

episodes.name: Dead Calm
episodes.overview: JJ's reckless behavior ramps up when the friends try to score some quick cash. Meanwhile, John B grows closer to Sarah — and makes her dad suspicious.

episodes.name: The Runway
episodes.overview: John B finally learns the truth about his dad — and sets off a chain of events that jeopardizes everything he and his friends have fought to accomplish.

episodes.name: The Bell Tower
episodes.overview: With his options dwindling and enemies closing in, John B looks for an exit plan. Sarah feels pressured to pick a side. Pope lets his emotions out.

episodes.name: The Phantom
episodes.overview: An island crawling with law enforcement and a looming tropical storm are just two of the obstacles facing John B as he tries to make his escape.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: With a fortune in gold at stake and their futures on the line, the Pogues rush headlong into danger and a fresh mystery as they face foes old and new.

episodes.name: The Gold
episodes.overview: John B tries to evade capture as he zeroes in on the gold, but a promise to Sarah could derail his plans. Back home, his friends face life without him.

episodes.name: The Heist
episodes.overview: With time running out, John B and Sarah strike an uneasy bargain, while Kiara, JJ and Pope search for evidence that could implicate Ward and Rafe.

episodes.name: Prayers
episodes.overview: A desperate scramble for help lands John B and Sarah in questionable surroundings. Pope receives a mysterious summons to an out-of-town meeting.

episodes.name: Homecoming
episodes.overview: Low on gas and strapped for cash, John B and Sarah run into trouble. Pope's appointment in Charleston takes an ominous turn over a proposed trade.

episodes.name: The Darkest Hour
episodes.overview: JJ cooks up a risky plan to help out John B. Pope hunts down information about the key. Kiara and Sarah both deal with family fallout over the Pogues.

episodes.name: My Druthers
episodes.overview: John B bristles when Sarah reconnects with a former flame. Ward's web of lies starts to unravel. Pope discovers a shocking family secret.

episodes.name: The Bonfire
episodes.overview: Reeling from Ward's actions, Sarah finds her loyalties to John B and the Pogues put to the test. At the annual bonfire, jealousies and tempers flare.

episodes.name: The Cross
episodes.overview: Armed with new clues, the group braves perilous roads and swampland as they race to keep part of Pope's history from falling into the wrong hands.

episodes.name: Trapped
episodes.overview: The Pogues deal with a slew of setbacks — a medical emergency, a nosy neighbor, parental ultimatums — as they attempt to save Pope's family legacy.

episodes.name: The Coastal Venture
episodes.overview: John B, Pope, JJ and Kiara brace for a showdown on board the ship, while Sarah realizes the harsh truth of her distressing family situation.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: New adventures take the Pogues to the Caribbean and far beyond as the friends are pulled into a dangerous rival's hunt for a legendary lost city.

episodes.name: Poguelandia
episodes.overview: An unexpected rescuer takes the Pogues from a remote island to Barbados, where they encounter a powerful treasure hunter with his own agenda.

episodes.name: The Bells
episodes.overview: As her friends mount a rescue attempt, Kiara agrees to an uneasy truce with Rafe. A familiar sound grabs John B's attention.

episodes.name: Fathers and Sons
episodes.overview: Big John and John B pick up where they left off — for better or worse. Cleo and Pope form a new club. Rafe reconnects with Ward.

episodes.name: The Diary
episodes.overview: An emotional homecoming is easier for some than others. Big John searches for the diary. Ward's plans for a prized possession don't sit well with Rafe.

episodes.name: Heists
episodes.overview: Sarah convinces an old friend to help with a high-risk, high-reward mission. Looking to access a museum collection, John B and his dad get creative.

episodes.name: The Dark Forest
episodes.overview: Secrets threaten to drive a wedge between John B and his friends. Sarah revisits a past life. Pope reaches a breaking point.

episodes.name: Happy Anniversary
episodes.overview: With Singh on the move, John B and JJ scramble to catch him. Pope makes a breakthrough. Sarah questions where her loyalties lie.

episodes.name: Tapping the Rudder
episodes.overview: Rafe lays his cards on the table and Sarah calls in two favors. JJ's unorthodox plan to get to South America lands John B in hot water.

episodes.name: Welcome to Kitty Hawk
episodes.overview: With their ride to Orinoco waiting on the tarmac, Kiara and JJ run into several complications. Rafe has a change of heart.

episodes.name: Secret of the Gnomon
episodes.overview: The Pogues' search for El Dorado brings them deep into the jungle, where John B and Sarah face the ultimate test of their courage and family bonds.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: The Pogues return home and start living their best life, but it's not long before they're back to doing what they do best: hunting for treasure.

episodes.name: The Enduro
episodes.overview: Flush with success, the Pogues have big plans to invest in their future. But when their fortunes take a turn, will a bold gamble pay off?

episodes.name: Blackbeard
episodes.overview: A strange tale of a family curse makes the Pogues think twice about accepting a lucrative offer to search for an amulet linked to Blackbeard.

episodes.name: The Lupine Corsairs
episodes.overview: The sheriff grills the Pogues about their dealings with Wes Genrette. JJ and Kiara have another close call. Pope gets wind of a mysterious artifact.

episodes.name: The Swell
episodes.overview: Tensions rise along with the waves when the Pogues and the Kooks hit the beach for the year's best swell. As Pope digs for info, Cleo faces down danger.

episodes.name: Albatross
episodes.overview: The Pogues scramble when the sheriff turns up at the worst possible time. JJ receives a mysterious letter. The amulet's clues point to Charleston.

episodes.name: The Town Council
episodes.overview: JJ learns about his past. The Pogues rally support for a zoning meeting that will decide their fate. Sarah and John B suss out a theory about the scroll.

episodes.name: Mothers and Fathers
episodes.overview: As a confrontation on Goat Island turns perilous, Sarah confirms a suspicion while searching for JJ, Pope's future falters, and Topper taunts John B.

episodes.name: Family Plot
episodes.overview: While JJ heads out on a grim mission with Groff, Sarah reveals her big news, Pope faces a moment of truth, and Rafe helps the sheriff connect the dots.

episodes.name: The Storm
episodes.overview: Pursued by police, the Pogues embark on the next stage of their mission with help from an unexpected source. Tensions flare when John B confides in JJ.

episodes.name: The Blue Crown
episodes.overview: The hunt for Groff heats up in Morocco. In a deadly race to claim the crown, loyalties are tested — and a moment of treachery changes everything.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: The fifth and final season.

shows.name: Peacemaker
shows.overview: The continuing story of Peacemaker, a vainglorious superhero/supervillain who believes in peace at any cost — no matter how many people he has to kill. After a miraculous recovery from his duel with Bloodsport, Peacemaker soon discovers that his freedom comes at a price.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: After surviving being shot and then buried beneath a collapsing building, Peacemaker returns home only to realize that his freedom comes at a price. He is now part of Amanda Waller's new team fighting a mysterious new threat. Can he eliminate the threat without making things worse?

episodes.name: A Whole New Whirled
episodes.overview: After making a miraculous recovery, Peacemaker returns home–only to discover that his freedom comes at a price.

episodes.name: Best Friends, For Never
episodes.overview: After Peacemaker’s hazardous escape, tension and mistrust build within the team. Later, as Peacemaker grapples with his new assignment, he receives a surprise visitor.

episodes.name: Better Goff Dead
episodes.overview: On their first official mission to assassinate suspected “butterflies,” Economos and Murn bond, and Peacemaker and Harcourt reach an understanding. But the whole job goes sideways with the arrival of Judomaster.

episodes.name: The Choad Less Traveled
episodes.overview: Following a somewhat successful mission, Murn recruits Vigilante. Meanwhile, after learning that the team helped land his father in prison, Peacemaker confronts his complicated past.

episodes.name: Monkey Dory
episodes.overview: The team scouts the apparent hub for the aliens’ food supply, only to come face-to-face with a full-fledged invasion. Meanwhile, Auggie’s attempt to sell out his son to the police is complicated by Murn’s mysterious contact.

episodes.name: Murn After Reading
episodes.overview: Murn reveals his deepest secret. Auggie is set free. The botched arrest of Peacemaker sends alien Goff into an unexpected new host.

episodes.name: Stop Dragon My Heart Around
episodes.overview: Harcourt, Murn, and Adebayo find themselves surrounded by an alien force, while Peacemaker squares off against his father with help from Vigilante and Economos.

episodes.name: It's Cow or Never
episodes.overview: With Peacemaker and Adebayo at odds, can the team kill the cow once and for all – or will their fracture give the aliens the opening they need to complete its teleportation?

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Following the exposure of Project Butterfly and the disbandment of Task Force X, the 11th Street Kids grapple with new identities, new friendships, and new rivalries. For Peacemaker, this means reconciling his past with his newfound sense of purpose — here and in an alternate dimension. Meanwhile, Rick Flag Sr. reappears as the director of A.R.G.U.S., focused on controlling metahumans and avenging the death of his son at the hands of Peacemaker.

episodes.name: The Ties That Grind
episodes.overview: While Peacemaker attempts to join the Justice Gang, Harcourt struggles to find work, and Economos takes on a challenging new assignment.

episodes.name: A Man Is Only As Good As His Bird
episodes.overview: As Economos clashes with his new handler, Peacemaker must deal with the consequences of his actions in the alternate dimension.

episodes.name: Another Rick Up My Sleeve
episodes.overview: Economos pays for the team's bungled mission, while Peacemaker explores the depths of his relationship with Harcourt in the other dimension.

episodes.name: Need I Say Door
episodes.overview: As A.R.G.U.S. ramps up efforts to find the QUC, Harcourt receives a tempting offer from Flag – which comes at a steep cost to Peacemaker.

episodes.name: Back to the Suture
episodes.overview: After a catastrophic showdown with Flag, Peacemaker makes a shocking decision, while his friends scramble to keep the 11th Street Kids together.

episodes.name: Ignorance Is Chris
episodes.overview: As the 11th Street Kids fight to bring their missing member home, Flag doubles down on his efforts to hold Peacemaker accountable.

episodes.name: Like a Keith in the Night
episodes.overview: As Flag and A.R.G.U.S. close in, the 11th Street Kids attempt to keep the ever-increasing dangers of the alternate world around them at bay.

episodes.name: Full Nelson
episodes.overview: As Flag puts everyone around him in increasing danger, the 11th Street Kids must convince Peacemaker that he's one of them.

shows.name: Percy Jackson and the Olympians
shows.overview: Percy Jackson is on a dangerous quest. Outrunning monsters and outwitting gods, he must journey across America to return Zeus's master bolt and stop an all-out war. With the help of his friends Annabeth and Grover, Percy's journey will lead him closer to the answers he seeks: how to fit into a world where he feels out of place, and who he's destined to be.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Percy Jackson sails to the Sea of Monsters to rescue his friend Grover and save Camp Half-Blood

episodes.name: We Check In to C.C.'s Spa & Resort
I Go Down with the Ship
The Fleece Works Its Magic Too Well

shows.name: Person of Interest
shows.overview: John Reese, former CIA paramilitary operative, is presumed dead and teams up with reclusive billionaire Finch to prevent violent crimes in New York City by initiating their own type of justice. With the special training that Reese has had in Covert Operations and Finch's genius software inventing mind, the two are a perfect match for the job that they have to complete. With the help of surveillance equipment, they work "outside the law" and get the right criminal behind bars.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A supercomputer developed by reclusive billionaire and software genius Harold Finch analyzes data patterns in surveillance for the U.S. government to identify impending acts of terrorism. But the computer, known only as "The Machine", can also identify ordinary people who are about to be involved in violent crimes. Can those crimes be stopped before they take place? Secretly tapping into The Machine, Finch and ex-CIA agent John Reese use vigilante tactics and state-of-the-art technology to identify the soon-to-be victims and prevent the crimes from occuring. Meanwhile, two NYPD detectives Joss Carter and Lionel Fusco are drawn into the cases and the mystery surrounding the two covert crime fighters.

episodes.name: Pilot
episodes.overview: When the social security number of a young prosecutor comes up, Reese and Finch work together to figure out if their person of interest is the victim or perpetrator.

episodes.name: Ghosts
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch question the machine's reliability when they are asked to investigate a teenager who was killed years earlier; Finch remembers the origin of the machine.

episodes.name: Mission Creep
episodes.overview: Reese goes undercover to find the threat surrounding the next person on Finch's list: a young army veteran named Joey Durban.

episodes.name: Cura Te Ipsum
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch get some help from Detective Fusco  as they surveil their latest POI, Dr. Megan Tillman, while she’s on call and after hours to unravel the threat surrounding the promising young physician.

episodes.name: Judgement
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch have the added challenge of investigating a Person of Interest who wants nothing to do with their brand of vigilante justice.

episodes.name: The Fix
episodes.overview: Reese becomes romantically involved with the newest Person of Interest: an attractive woman who isn't all that she seems.

episodes.name: Witness
episodes.overview: The Machine identifies a school teacher who witnessed a mob hit as their next POI and Reese and Finch rush to save his life.

episodes.name: Foe
episodes.overview: When Reese and Finch discover that their latest POI has connections to Cold War Soviet espionage circles, they quickly learn how covert ops were handled in a world before The Machine.

episodes.name: Get Carter
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch’s game of cat and mouse with Detective Carter becomes infinitely more complicated when The Machine declares that she is their newest POI.

episodes.name: Number Crunch
episodes.overview: As Detective Carter deals with the fallout from her recent encounter with Reese and Finch, The Machine ups the ante for the duo by giving them four Social Security numbers instead of one.

episodes.name: Super
episodes.overview: Reese is confined to a wheelchair recovering from his gunshot wound, but Finch sets him up in an apartment where he’s to keep an eye on the Super, who is their latest POI. Also, Finch approaches Carter and gives her a POI to show her what they do.

episodes.name: Legacy
episodes.overview: When Carter finally comes face-to-face with Reese, he urges her to join forces to help with their latest POI, a scrappy young woman from the wrong side of the tracks who turned her life around and became a lawyer.

episodes.name: Root Cause
episodes.overview: The Machine gives Reese and Finch the number of a down-and-out man who has been pushed too far, and they're forced to turn to former Person of Interest, Zoe Morgan, for help.

episodes.name: Wolf and Cub
episodes.overview: The Machine identifies Darren, a teenager whose brother was just murdered, as the next POI. Meanwhile, Finch is growing concerned that the son of his former business partner is dangerously close to finding out about the Machine.

episodes.name: Blue Code
episodes.overview: Reese discovers there’s more to the story after he infiltrates a smuggling ring to get close to his latest POI.

episodes.name: Risk
episodes.overview: The Machine leads Reese and Finch to Wall Street when a sharp young trader at a major investment bank becomes embroiled in a multi-million dollar financial scam.

episodes.name: Baby Blue
episodes.overview: When The Machine spits out the number of a 6-month-old baby, Reese and Finch turn into overly protective parents – with an arsenal at their disposal. Meanwhile, when Elias resurfaces, Detective Carter begins to question her new allegiance with Reese and Finch.

episodes.name: Identity Crisis
episodes.overview: The Machine's latest number presents a unique challenge for Reese and Finch since the person has virtually no digital footprint - and appears to be leading a double life.

episodes.name: Flesh and Blood
episodes.overview: When The Machine spits out five numbers, naming the Don of each of New York’s crime families, Reese and Finch suspect Elias is planning to eliminate his competition.

episodes.name: Matsya Nyaya
episodes.overview: Reese goes undercover as an armored car company employee, and faces memories from his past with the CIA.

episodes.name: Many Happy Returns
episodes.overview: Finch gives Reese his birthday off so that his partner doesn't have to face a Number that is tied to Reese's past.

episodes.name: No Good Deed
episodes.overview: The newest POI’s curiosity could spell his doom when he finds himself embroiled in a dark government conspiracy – one that Finch is all too familiar with. Meanwhile, Reese uncovers something revealing about Finch’s past.

episodes.name: Firewall
episodes.overview: As the clock ticks down, Reese winds up trapped with his POI in the most heavily surveilled part of the city, forced to rely on the help of Finch, Carter and Fusco to fend off the FBI, corrupt cops and a slew of old foes.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: The Machine identifies another gripping season's worth of potential crimes that must be stopped. Adversaries from Reese's undercover past and Finch's government work threaten the team's crime-fighting mission and anonymity. Meanwhile, Detectives Carter and Fusco face down FBI probes and the dangerous tentacles of the police conspiracy known as "HR".

episodes.name: The Contingency
episodes.overview: With Finch missing – kidnapped by his hacker nemesis, Root, Reese enlists Detectives Carter and Fusco to get his friend back, Meanwhile, The Machine never sleeps, disseminating a new number to Reese.

episodes.name: Bad Code
episodes.overview: The Machine delivers the number of a cold case that leads Reese ever closer to catching up with Finch and his kidnapper, Root.

episodes.name: Masquerade
episodes.overview: With Finch back in the Library, Reese returns to field work, only to face his toughest case yet – protecting the privileged daughter of a Brazilian diplomat.

episodes.name: Triggerman
episodes.overview: When The Machine gives them the number of a mob enforcer whose life becomes endangered, Reese and Finch must decide whether to intervene or allow karma to balance the scales of justice. Meanwhile, Finch seeks aid from an unlikely source.

episodes.name: Bury the Lede
episodes.overview: Reese must protect an investigative journalist through surreptitious means to avoid becoming part of her story.

episodes.name: The High Road
episodes.overview: Reese goes undercover in an idyllic neighborhood when The Machine’s latest number sends him to the suburbs.

episodes.name: Critical
episodes.overview: The Machine gives Finch and Reese the number of a brilliant surgeon, but they soon discover that a resourceful third party has raised the stakes for this POI, forcing them to turn to an unlikely source for help.

episodes.name: Til Death
episodes.overview: The team is spread thin when a husband and wife’s numbers both come up

episodes.name: C.O.D.
episodes.overview: When the machine names a New York cabdriver as a person of interest, any of his passengers could be a part of the impending crime.

episodes.name: Shadow Box
episodes.overview: As the FBI pursues "the man in the suit," Reese is even more determined to protect the latest person of interest after learning she is the sister of a soldier who was killed in action.

episodes.name: 2πR
episodes.overview: Finch goes under cover to protect a youth who reminds him of himself; Carter goes on a dangerous mission for the FBI.

episodes.name: Prisoner's Dilemma
episodes.overview: Carter tries to help Reese by engaging in mental warfare with the FBI; Reese has encounters with old and new enemies; Detective Fusco must protect supermodel Karolina Kurkova, the latest person of interest.

episodes.name: Dead Reckoning
episodes.overview: Reese is abducted by a former acquaintance planning a massive and potentially deadly act of cyber-warfare.

episodes.name: One Percent
episodes.overview: Finch and Reese meet their match: a tech billionaire whose curiosity and endless resources could expose their identities and ruin their efforts to save his life.

episodes.name: Booked Solid
episodes.overview: As Reese and Finch try to save a hotel maid's life, they encounter a litany of suspects; Detective Carter considers a significant offer from the FBI.

episodes.name: Relevance
episodes.overview: A lethal government operative who tracks and stops terrorist threats before they occur finds herself on the run – and the new focus of Reese and Finch's attention. However, their pursuit proves to be their most formidable when they discover that her remarkable skill set equals their own.

episodes.name: Proteus
episodes.overview: As Finch and Reese try to protect six people simultaneously, clues lead them to a coastal town; when a storm forces Finch and Reese to seek shelter in a police station with a group of locals, they realize a killer may be in their midst.

episodes.name: All In
episodes.overview: Finch and Reese head to Atlantic City to protect the latest person of interest, an elderly gambler; Carter tries to clear another detective's name.

episodes.name: Trojan Horse
episodes.overview: Finch infiltrates a tech corporation to gather intel on an executive whose number has come up; Carter questions Beecher's integrity.

episodes.name: In Extremis
episodes.overview: When a person of interest is poisoned, Finch and Reese only have 24 hours to identify the toxin and find the person responsible; Detective Fusco's past catches up to him.

episodes.name: Zero Day
episodes.overview: When a virus causes the machine to malfunction, numbers are issued irregularly; the team searches for an extremely elusive tech millionaire.

episodes.name: God Mode
episodes.overview: Finch and Reese team up with unexpected allies as they race to fix the machine; as Detective Carter tries to apprehend Cal Beecher's murderer, she finds herself up against HR -- a criminal organization.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: The team suffers a devastating loss and confront staggering challenges. Adapting to the next evolution of The Machine, now completely self-governed and hidden from all, Finch and Reese team with rogue agent Sameen Shaw to save lives and seek justice, but their missions now threaten to tear them apart. Joss Carter and Lionel Fusco finally unravel the criminal police conspiracy "HR" - but at a tragic cost. And former cyber-enemy — and now highly tuned confederate of The Machine — Root becomes an unpredictable ally when the team learns a second surveillance apparatus to rival The Machine is on the verge of activation.

episodes.name: Liberty
episodes.overview: The Machine, now completely self-governed with its whereabouts unknown, resumes giving Finch its "irrelevant" numbers for people in danger, which include a U.S. naval officer in town for Fleet Week. However, with so many sailors flooding the streets of New York City, finding the officer in time presents an even bigger challenge for Reese and Shaw.

episodes.name: Nothing to Hide
episodes.overview: The number comes up for an Internet entrepreneur in the business of eliminating people's privacy, but finds his own being rapidly stripped away. As his life spirals out of control, Reese tries to protect him while Finch calls on Shaw, Carter and Fusco for help finding whoever is after him.

episodes.name: Lady Killer
episodes.overview: The team suspects the latest number to be a potential stalker/ killer. Root plots her escape from the institution and gives her psychiatrist a big surprise.

episodes.name: Reasonable Doubt
episodes.overview: The team must figure out if a prominent lawyer orchestrated the murder of her husband or if she is being framed; Carter is spotted with Reese by her new partner.

episodes.name: Razgovor
episodes.overview: Shaw must stay close to a 10-year-old girl with highly developed surveillance skills when she is identified by the machine; Carter's mission could be exposed.

episodes.name: Mors Praematura
episodes.overview: After being freed from her confinement to the psych ward, Root needs Shaw's help with a directive from the machine; Finch and Reese look into a mild-mannered investigator.

episodes.name: The Perfect Mark
episodes.overview: The team is met with surprises during an investigation into a hypnotherapist; an antiquities dealer has ties to a crime organization.

episodes.name: Endgame
episodes.overview: The machine gives Finch 38 numbers at once; information about Carter's past is revealed.

episodes.name: The Crossing
episodes.overview: The battle to bring a crime organization to justice reaches a new level; Reese's number comes up in the machine.

episodes.name: The Devil's Share
episodes.overview: As the POI team seeks justice for Carter’s murder, Finch realizes one of his team members may go one step too far in order to end the war with HR. Also, The Machine gives out the number for NYPD Officer Patrick Simmons, one of the crime organization’s key players.

episodes.name: Lethe
episodes.overview: Flashbacks to Finch’s adolescence provide insight into his creation of The Machine. Also, the team receives the number of an already dying man, and Reese leaves the POI team behind in the aftermath of the war with the crime organization, HR.

episodes.name: Aletheia
episodes.overview: Multiple enemies converge on the POI team as they protect a dying man whose number has come up. They struggle to keep their enemies at bay but without Reese, who has left them and their mission behind following the tragic war with HR, being down one man could have catastrophic repercussions for the team.

episodes.name: 4C
episodes.overview: Reese boards an international flight in an attempt to put the team and the past behind him, but is angered when he realizes his travel plans have been manipulated.

episodes.name: Provenance
episodes.overview: Reese rejoins Finch in New York, but when the team receives the number of a highly skilled antiquities thief, a surprising turn of events finds them planning a heist which could land them all in jail.

episodes.name: Last Call
episodes.overview: Finch goes undercover in an emergency call center to protect a 911 operator, but it soon becomes clear that the threat reaches further than the team could have anticipated.

episodes.name: RAM
episodes.overview: The secrets of Finch’s operation before he enlisted Reese are revealed, including shocking ties to present-day events.
The Machine assigns Root to seek out a janitor with a mysterious past, but when her very presence puts his life in danger, Finch also receives his number.

episodes.name: Allegiance
episodes.overview: Finch and Reese must delve into the murky waters of international politics when they are given the number of a former government contractor who is stalking a UN diplomat. Also, an enemy attempts to gain an upper hand on Root.

episodes.name: Most Likely To...
episodes.overview: Reese and Shaw pose as alumni at a high school reunion in order to keep eyes on the latest POI. Meanwhile, Finch and Fusco travel to Washington, D.C., to investigate the motivations behind Vigilance’s latest attack.

episodes.name: Death Benefit
episodes.overview: Reese poses as a Secret Service agent to get close to the latest POI, a U.S. congressman who may hold the key to derailing Decima’s plans to bring a second Machine online.

episodes.name: Beta
episodes.overview: As Decima uses Samaritan’s feeds to hunt Reese and Shaw, Greer exploits Finch’s greatest weakness in an attempt to lure him out of hiding: his love for his former fiancée, Grace Hendricks.

episodes.name: A House Divided
episodes.overview: When an unknown entity prevents The Machine from seeing the full picture of an impending catastrophic event, it sends the team five separate numbers to help them piece together the bigger picture. Meanwhile, Root’s team of hackers arrives in New York.

episodes.name: Deus Ex Machina
episodes.overview: The team takes desperate action in its race to prevent the malevolent AI program Samaritan from coming online and making them its first targets. Meanwhile, the months-long battle with the anti-surveillance terrorist group Vigilance comes to a shocking conclusion.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Although they’ve saved countless lives thanks to The Machine’s omniscience, John Reese and Harold Finch, along with lethal operative Sameen Shaw and unpredictable cyber-hacker Root now face an uncertain future. With a second machine — Samaritan — now online, the elusive team are now targets themselves, hiding in plain sight. The only thing more frightening than the ruthless Decima organization calling the shots is leaving those decisions up to an untested Machine. Facing a dangerous tomorrow, the POI team must find a way to outsmart Samaritan, an all-seeing, all-powerful artificial intelligence that’s self-governing, continually evolving and growing stronger every day.

episodes.name: Panopticon
episodes.overview: Forced to take on new identities provided by Root, the team members try to adapt to their new lives. However, some find it hard to ignore The Machine's numbers, which puts them all at risk of being detected by Samaritan.

episodes.name: Nautilus
episodes.overview: Despite not wanting to help with the new numbers, Finch's interest is piqued when the newest person of interest turns out to be a brilliant college student involved with a mysterious scavenger hunt.

episodes.name: Wingman
episodes.overview: Finch recruits Fusco to stick close to the latest POI, a professional 'wingman', but learning how to approach women soon becomes the least of his worries. Reese must find a way to play by the rules at his new day job. The Machine sends Finch and Root on a mysterious errand.

episodes.name: Brotherhood
episodes.overview: Reese's cover job as a detective at the NYPD becomes complicated when the young brother and sister he's protecting become targets of a gang investigation.

episodes.name: Prophets
episodes.overview: While Reese is forced to go to counseling for his violent tendencies, Root, Shaw and Finch try to help a new POI.

episodes.name: Pretenders
episodes.overview: Reese, Shaw and Fusco must protect a unassuming office worker who stumbles into a dangerous conspiracy while moonlighting as fake detective. Finch travels to Hong Kong as part of his academic cover identity.

episodes.name: Honor Among Thieves
episodes.overview: Shaw joins a team of international thieves in order to keep tabs on the latest POI, but an unexpected turn of events puts her in danger of being detected by Samaritan.  Also, Finch and Root undertake a dangerous sabotage mission.

episodes.name: Point of Origin
episodes.overview: Reese volunteers as an NYPD police academy instructor in order to keep an eye on a talented young officer whose suspicious actions make him question her motives. Meanwhile, Martine – armed with information from Samaritan – hunts a member of the team.

episodes.name: The Devil You Know
episodes.overview: Reese must save Elias from the Brotherhood. He can't get any help from Root or Shaw since Shaw's cover is blown and Root is escorting her to underground.

episodes.name: The Cold War
episodes.overview: Samaritan shows its power by erasing crime from the city for a day in an attempt to force The Machine out of hiding.

episodes.name: If-Then-Else
episodes.overview: Samaritan launches a cyber-attack on the stock exchange, forcing the team to risk their lives in a desperate mission to stop a global economic catastrophe.

episodes.name: Control-Alt-Delete
episodes.overview: Control, who oversees the handling of relevant numbers for the government, begins to question the methods and intentions of the Samaritan program. Also, alarming news reports of a pair of vigilantes rampaging through the Northeast begin to surface.

episodes.name: M.I.A.
episodes.overview: Root and Reese investigate a small town in upstate New York that holds the key to Shaw's location... and whether she's dead or alive.

episodes.name: Guilty
episodes.overview: When the Machine arranges for Finch to sit on the jury of a murder trial, he begins to suspect that a fellow juror is set to rig the proceedings. Meanwhile, Reese begins to open up to the department’s therapist.

episodes.name: Q&A
episodes.overview: Reese tries to protect a software programmer with a mysterious second life, but it’s unclear which side of her life the threat is coming from. Meanwhile, Claire, a young hacker whom Finch tried to protect from Samaritan, reaches out to him for aid.

episodes.name: Blunt
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch must protect Harper, a street-smart grifter, when her plan to steal cash from a medical marijuana dispensary goes up in smoke.

episodes.name: Karma
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch try to protect a psychologist whose unorthodox methods for helping his patients find closure could cost him dearly. Meanwhile, flashbacks reveal Finch’s fragile state in the days following the bombing that killed his best friend, Nathan Ingram.

episodes.name: Skip
episodes.overview: Reese must protect a bounty hunter who refuses to allow the potential threat to her life sway her from the relentless pursuit of her target. Also, Finch tries to set the plan he began in Shanghai in motion.

episodes.name: Search and Destroy
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch scramble to protect a software CEO when his behavior becomes increasingly erratic following a hacker attack that reveals all his secrets and unravels his life.

episodes.name: Terra Incognita
episodes.overview: Reese finds himself on a dangerous personal journey when he takes on a homicide case Detective Carter was never able to close.

episodes.name: Asylum
episodes.overview: Reese and Fusco get caught in the war between the two newest POIs, rival crime bosses Elias and Dominic. Also, a tantalizing clue to Shaw’s whereabouts leads Finch and Root into a possible trap, and Control goes rogue to uncover the true intentions of the Samaritan program.

episodes.name: YHWH
episodes.overview: Finch and Root race to save The Machine, which has been located by the rival AI, Samaritan. Also, Reese is caught in the middle of the final showdown between rival crime bosses Elias and Dominic.

seasons.name: Season 5
seasons.overview: For years, the Person of Interest team have been protected by The Machine, but as worlds collided and a rival AI known as Samaritan finally cornered The Machine inside the nation’s power grid, it was the POI team’s turn to protect Finch’s creation. In season five, the cold war is over. The world around us might look the same, but something has drastically changed. Samaritan’s lethal “correction” has initiated its control. Finch’s Machine is essentially dead. Shaw is still missing. And the team is once again hiding in plain sight. But with Samaritan’s invisible grip tightening everywhere, will Finch be able to rebuild and resurrect The Machine? And if he does, will it be the same Machine when it comes back online?

episodes.name: B.S.O.D.
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch attempt to rescue the Machine’s source code before it deteriorates beyond repair. Also, Root fights for her life against an onslaught of Samaritan’s agents and Fusco is faced with hard questions following the deaths of Dominic and Elias.

episodes.name: SNAFU
episodes.overview: The Machine experiences a glitch during rebooting, supplying Reese and Fusco with the numbers of dozens of people not actually involved in crimes, while also locking Finch and Root out after identifying them as threats based on past violent behavior.

episodes.name: Truth Be Told
episodes.overview: Reese’s cover could be blown when he realizes the latest POI has ties to his old CIA colleague, Kara Stanton.
Shaw escapes her captors, but the team is unsure of her mental state when she begins to act paranoid and reckless.

episodes.name: ShotSeeker
episodes.overview: Reese protects an NYPD analyst whose investigation into a software glitch has drawn the attention of Samaritan. Also, Reese and Fusco are threatened by an ally of Elias’s, who is looking to avenge his friend’s death.

episodes.name: A More Perfect Union
episodes.overview: The Machine sends Reese and Finch to a wedding to protect a pair of POIs before their nuptials. Also, Fusco becomes angry at being kept in the dark by the team and takes it upon himself to investigate a string of missing person reports.

episodes.name: QSO
episodes.overview: Root goes undercover at a radio station to protect the host of a conspiracy theory show who stumbles upon information that could get him killed. Also, Samaritan’s agents try to convince a member of the team that their goals are noble.

episodes.name: Reassortment
episodes.overview: Reese and Finch become trapped in a hospital that becomes ground zero for a deadly viral outbreak. Also, Samaritan’s newest recruit has second thoughts and Shaw continues to struggle with reality.

episodes.name: Sotto Voce
episodes.overview: The mysterious criminal mastermind known as “The Voice” returns and traps Reese and Fusco in their own precinct with several armed gang members and the latest POI. Also, Root makes a shocking discovery.

episodes.name: The Day the World Went Away
episodes.overview: Finch’s number comes up when a fatal error blows his cover identity and sets off a deadly series of escalating encounters with Samaritan’s operatives.

episodes.name: Synecdoche
episodes.overview: The team must unravel a conspiracy and stay ahead of the Secret Service when the President of the United States becomes their newest POI. Also, Finch separates himself from the team and considers taking drastic action to combat Samaritan.

episodes.name: .exe
episodes.overview: As Reese and Shaw race to catch up with Finch, he infiltrates a maximum-security government facility in a desperate mission which could mean the end for not only Samaritan, but for himself and The Machine as well.

episodes.name: return 0
episodes.overview: Finch, Reese, Fusco and Shaw embark on one last mission to prevent Samaritan from destroying The Machine and cementing its hold over mankind.

shows.name: Pluribus
shows.overview: The most miserable person on Earth must save the world from happiness.

episodes.name: We Is Us
episodes.overview: An astronomer's discovery turns the planet upside down. Carol Sturka, a curmudgeonly novelist, is terrified by this strange new world.

episodes.name: Pirate Lady
episodes.overview: A curiously familiar face introduces Carol to the bizarre new normal. A gathering in Europe brings strangers together...and causes friction.

episodes.name: Grenade
episodes.overview: The World just wants to help—which infuriates Carol. A heart-to-heart conversation ends with a bang.

episodes.name: Please, Carol
episodes.overview: Carol tests the boundaries of this weirdly honest world at the expense of her ego. Far away, a resolute individual learns he's not alone.

episodes.name: Got Milk
episodes.overview: Carol doubles down on her investigation—loneliness be damned. Meanwhile, howls in the night reveal a new source of danger.

episodes.name: HDP
episodes.overview: Carol shares a horrific discovery and learns new truths in the process. Mr. Diabaté lives life to the fullest in Sin City.

shows.name: Power Book IV: Force
shows.overview: Tommy Egan leaves New York behind and plans to take on Chicago, using his outsider status to break all the local rules and rewrite them on his quest to become the biggest drug dealer in the city.

episodes.name: Do or Die
episodes.overview: With some of his biggest obstacles off the map, Tommy faces new opportunities and challenges in his quest to take over the Chicago drug game.

episodes.name: A Seat at the Table

shows.name: Rag, Tag and Bobtail
shows.overview:
Rag, Tag and Bobtail was a BBC children's television programme that ran from 1953 to 1965 as the Thursday programme in the weekly cycle of Watch With Mother. The scripts were written by Louise Cochrane, and the series was produced by Freda Lingstrom and David Boisseau. Narration was by Charles E. Stidwell, David Enders, and James Urquhart.

The three main characters were Rag, a hedgehog; Tag, a mouse; and Bobtail, a rabbit; five baby rabbits also appeared occasionally. All the characters were glove puppets, operated by Sam and Elizabeth Williams. The stories were simple and there were no catch-phrases as there were in other programmes in the cycle, but the series is still remembered with affection. Twenty-six 12-minute episodes were made, two of which were never broadcast, each shot in a single take.

In 1987, a Watch With Mother video was released by the BBC. The episode of Rag, Tag and Bobtail featured a scene in which Bobtail discovered that the baby rabbits had been playing in a muddy pool and had turned black. He was unable to clean them, but in the end the mud was washed off.

episodes.name: The Heat Is On

episodes.name: Walk the Line

episodes.name: Into the Fold
episodes.overview: After a new Bobby Dazzler is unearthed on Lot 5, the Oak Island team makes a discovery with possible religious implications.

shows.name: The Diplomat
shows.overview: Amid an international crisis, a US diplomat contends with her high-profile job as ambassador to the UK and her strained marriage to a political star.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Amid an international crisis, a career diplomat juggles her new high-profile job as ambassador to the UK and her turbulent marriage to a political star.

episodes.name: The Cinderella Thing
episodes.overview: After a hostile attack on a British vessel, seasoned diplomat Kate Wyler assumes a new role in the UK that puts her skills — and marriage — to the test.

episodes.name: Don't Call It a Kidnapping
episodes.overview: As new details about the bombing emerge, Kate struggles to see eye-to-eye with Hal. Prime Minister Trowbridge's fiery remarks at a funeral cause a stir.

episodes.name: Lambs in the Dark
episodes.overview: At Winfield, President Rayburn's plans in the Gulf have the staff on edge as tensions between a determined Hal and a strong-willed Kate come to a head.

episodes.name: He Bought a Hat
episodes.overview: As Rayburn's rep takes a hit, Kate drops in on Dennison's private meeting at the UK Foreign Office and learns startling information about the attack.

episodes.name: The Dogcatcher
episodes.overview: Tempers flare at Chevening House, where an unexpected guest's arrival sends Kate and Dennison scrambling for a resolution. Hal makes a new connection.

episodes.name: Some Lusty Tornado
episodes.overview: To appease Trowbridge, Kate seeks Hal's help with a high-profile visitor and consults an informed source in secret as complicated feelings begin to grow.

episodes.name: Keep Your Enemies Closer
episodes.overview: After a sit-down with a Russian ambassador leads to new intel and mixed messages, Kate takes a trip to the Oval Office and reconnects with an old friend.

episodes.name: The James Bond Clause
episodes.overview: In London, Hal's actions cause friction as Kate heads to Paris with Dennison to get a handle on the Lenkov situation, which soon takes a shocking turn.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: When a London bombing shatters her world, US diplomat Kate Wyler faces the ultimate test as her suspicions reach the top levels of the British government.

episodes.name: When a Stranger Calls
episodes.overview: After rushing back to London, Kate shares her suspicions about the bombing. The search is on for Lenkov — and Roylin. Eidra delivers devastating news.

episodes.name: St. Paul's
episodes.overview: Eidra helps sneak an unannounced guest into Grove's funeral, Kate realizes she might have made a bad call before the bombing, and Stuart speaks his mind.

episodes.name: The Ides of March
episodes.overview: A lavish Fourth of July party gives Kate a chance to help Dennison, who sees an opportunity after the prime minister's announcement about Lenkov.

episodes.name: The Other Army
episodes.overview: Kate proposes a unique solution to the Roylin problem. A risky plan unfolds at the prime minister's event in Scotland. Stuart confronts his feelings.

episodes.name: Our Lady of Immaculate Deception
episodes.overview: Vice President Grace Penn arrives in London with an agenda — and advice — as fallout from Roylin's bombshell affects Kate's relationship with Trowbridge.

episodes.name: Dreadnought
episodes.overview: Kate puts her best foot forward after pillow talk with Hal forces her to face hard truths, and Vice President Penn offers a blunt lesson in geopolitics.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Ambassador Kate Wyler lives the particular nightmare that is getting what you want. She just accused Vice President Grace Penn of hatching a terrorist plot and admitted she's after the VP's job. But now the President is dead, Kate's husband Hal may have inadvertently killed him, and Grace Penn is leader of the free world. None of this slows Hal's campaign to land Kate the vice presidency. Kate steps into a role she never wanted, with a freedom she never expected, an increasingly complicated friendship with Foreign Secretary Austin Dennison, and an unnerving bond with First Gentleman Todd Penn.

episodes.name: Emperor Dead
episodes.overview: Amid a growing constitutional crisis, the staff scrambles to stage an impromptu inauguration, while Hal exploits the chaos behind the scenes.

episodes.name: Last Dance at the Country Club
episodes.overview: Kate weighs a compelling offer. Eidra faces scrutiny over fallout from the Roylin debacle. Stuart pitches a proposal that goes far deeper than policy.

episodes.name: The Riderless Horse
episodes.overview: As the nation pauses to mourn, Grace considers the framework of her administration. Private strain threatens Kate and Hal's polished public image.

episodes.name: Arden
episodes.overview: Kate's unique role grants her access to anyone she wants — except the one person she needs. Dennison puts actionable intelligence to personal use.

episodes.name: Birdwatchers
episodes.overview: Forced to play the perfect couple, Kate and Hal confront a looming problem in international waters and a development that could torpedo U.S. credibility.

episodes.name: Amagansett
episodes.overview: At an emergency strategy session, Grace weighs unthinkable choices, while Kate rolls the dice on a gamble that could alter the course of history.

episodes.name: PNG
episodes.overview: Sequestered inside Winfield House as embassies go on alert and allies fall silent, Kate and Callum race to contain a potential disaster.

episodes.name: Schrodinger's Wife
episodes.overview: Kate must use all her leverage and political instincts to avert a catastrophe at a high-stakes summit — with the fate of nations hanging in the balance.

shows.name: The Expanse
shows.overview: A thriller set two hundred years in the future following the case of a missing young woman who brings a hardened detective and a rogue ship's captain together in a race across the solar system to expose the greatest conspiracy in human history.

shows.name: The Last Frontier
shows.overview: When a prison transport plane crashes in the remote Alaskan wilderness—freeing dozens of violent inmates—the region's lone marshal must protect the town he's vowed to keep safe.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: When a lone U.S. marshal's jurisdiction is turned upside down after a prison transport plane crashes in the remote wilderness, setting free dozens of violent inmates, he begins to suspect the crash was not an accident.

episodes.name: Blue Skies
episodes.overview: An unprecedented emergency sends Fairbanks into lockdown. Frank gathers every resource available to mount a full-scale response.

episodes.name: Wind of Change
episodes.overview: Luke tries to get back home as the manhunt for Havlock intensifies. Frank weighs whether he should give in to a set of demands.

episodes.name: Country as F**k
episodes.overview: Sarah's disappearance adds urgency to Frank's search. Havlock's master plan takes an unexpected turn, increasing the number of hostages.

episodes.name: American Dream
episodes.overview: A state trooper goes missing, widening Frank's investigation. Armed locals join the manhunt. Sarah grows concerned over Luke's whereabouts.

episodes.name: Arnaq
episodes.overview: Frank focuses on tracking down Luke. The CIA's involvement ramps up as Havlock's plan enters a new phase.

episodes.name: The Devil Wears a Suit and Tie
episodes.overview: Fairbanks is hit with a mass power outage. Sarah spots someone suspicious in the ER. Sidney tries to get control of a key piece of evidence.

episodes.name: Change of Time
episodes.overview: A mysterious new suspect is interrogated. Frank's secret comes to light. Havlock works on retrieving the contents of his hard drive.

episodes.name: L'air Perdu
episodes.overview: Sidney learns about her father's past, the Atwater Protocol, and the classified intel in Archive 6.

episodes.name: Converge
episodes.overview: Bradford lands in Fairbanks with a CIA task force and new primary target. Sidney makes a desperate attempt to expose the truth.

episodes.name: Everything Trying
episodes.overview: Sidney and Havlock risk it all to gain possession of the archive. Frank sets out on a life-saving mission.

shows.name: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
shows.overview: A Librarian from the past time travels to the present and finds himself stuck here. When he returns to his castle, which is now a museum, he inadvertently releases magic across the continent. He is given a new team to help him clean up the mess he made, forming a new team of Librarians.

episodes.name: And the Deadly Drekavac
episodes.overview: When a Librarian from 200 years ago reappears today, he brings back to life a long-closed magical Library and accidentally resurrects an evil Drekavac. The Librarian, along with a quickly assembled team, must stop the Drekavac before it can kill and multiply.

episodes.name: And the Dance of Doom
episodes.overview: Our newly assembled Librarians crew investigates a mysterious "dancing sickness," leading them to a showdown with a powerful magical factioneer at a professional ballet company.

episodes.name: And the Ghost Train
episodes.overview: Half of the team becomes trapped on a runaway ghost train, and the rest of the team must help solve the unresolved business of the ghosts on board.

episodes.name: And the Thief of Love
episodes.overview: The Librarians head to Paris after a string of robberies leaves mysteriously lovestruck victims in their wake.

episodes.name: And the Memory Crystal
episodes.overview: The team goes to a college campus with a world-class observatory to discover who is using the Crystal of Dr. John Dee to steal people's memories, in order to own the future.

episodes.name: And the House of Cards
episodes.overview: When the magic door reroutes Charlie, Lysa and Connor to a bizarre manor where a series of Agatha Christie-style murders take place, they must figure out whodunnit, while Vikram tries to track them down with the help of a mysterious tarot card reader.

episodes.name: And the Con-Con
episodes.overview: Connor is forced to reconnect with people from his pre-Library life, and must defeat an old adversary who has grown powerful in his absence.

episodes.name: And the Hangover from Hell
episodes.overview: After a wild bachelorette party with Lysa's childhood best friend, the team wakes up in rough shape and hungover, with no idea how they ended up where they are.

episodes.name: And the Feast of the Vampir
episodes.overview: While on a visit to a small-town festival, Connor encounters the very first vampire, and finds himself fighting the clock to save himself from turning into one.

episodes.name: And Going Medieval
episodes.overview: When Vikram attempts to return to 1847 (via a homemade time machine), he inadvertently travels the entire team back to the days of King Arthur, where they learn the truth about a Knight of the Round Table, Camelot, and ... Elaine.

episodes.name: And the Graffiti of the Gods
episodes.overview: When graffiti starts coming to life and threatening a teenage girl, the team have to work out how these strange events are related to Gregor's Hammer -- and the imminent return of Gregor himself.

episodes.name: And the Unfinished Business
episodes.overview: General Gregor retrieves the Sword of Mars and uses it to take over the country of Caucasylvia (remember from the Train episode), gaining control of their nuclear arsenal. The team must steal the Sword to prevent world calamity.

shows.name: The Masked Singer
shows.overview: Celebrities compete in a singing competition with one major twist: each singer is shrouded from head to toe in an elaborate costume, complete with full face mask to conceal his or her identity. One singer will be eliminated each week, ultimately revealing his or her true identity.

episodes.name: Lucky Season 13: Group A Premiere
episodes.overview: Contestants from Group A perform hits like "SexyBack," "Just Give Me a Reason," "The Door," "La Bamba" and "Mad World."

episodes.name: Shrek Night
episodes.overview: Group A channels their inner fairytale by performing songs from or inspired by the "Shrek" movie franchise.

episodes.name: Group A Finals: A Rat Pack Tribute Night
episodes.overview: It's "Rat Pack Night" on The Masked Singer! Get ready for The Masked Singer's resident crooner, Robin Thicke, to Fly You To The Moon when he opens the show with the classic alongside Group A's Ant, Paparazzo and Coral. This evening's tribute to the Rat Pack has even more action than a Vegas casino! Group A will swoon, sing and serenade the audience with some of the Rat Pack's most iconic classics including, "Luck Be A Lady," "Fever," "That's Amore" and "My Way!"

episodes.name: Group B Premiere: Voices of Olympus
episodes.overview: Five new masks appear as the Voices of Olympus; contestants perform showstopping renditions of "I Believe In a Thing Called Love," "Bad Blood," "Rewrite the Stars," "Espresso" and "Saving All My Love For You."

episodes.name: Ghostbusters Night
episodes.overview: The panelists transform into ghost busting detectives along with an iconic visit from an original Ghostbuster, Ernie Hudson! Group B ain't afraid of no ghosts! They bring the house down with amazing performances of "(Don't Fear) The Reaper," "Disturbia," "Cleanin' Up The Town," and "Radioactive" before one celebrity must reveal themselves.

episodes.name: Group B Finals: Grand Ole Opry Night
episodes.overview: The Group B finalists perform "Save a Horse (Ride a Cowboy), and renditions of "Here You Come Again," "Take Me Home, Country Roads" and "Something in the Water."

episodes.name: Group C Premiere: Carnival Night
episodes.overview: The celebrities deliver astounding performances of "Hot To Go," "Jump Around," "Roxanne," "Let's Get Loud," and "Unwell" before one celebrity must reveal themselves.

episodes.name: Boy Band Night
episodes.overview: Paying tribute to boy bands; contestants perform iconic boy band classics like "Tearin' Up My Heart," "Poison," "Step By Step," and "I Swear."

episodes.name: Group C Finals: Decades Night
episodes.overview: Group C opens the show with a rockstar performance of "My Sharona" before the celebrities bring the house down with renditions of "Stop! In The Name Of Love," "Love Yourself," "Can't Fight This Feeling," and "Hard to Handle." One celebrity automatically advances to the Lucky Six while two battle it out in an electrifying Battle Royale to see who moves along to the Lucky Six and who must reveal themselves.

episodes.name: The Lucky 6: Merging of the Masks
episodes.overview: It's time for a "Merging Of The Masks" for the Lucky 6 on The Masked Singer! The final six celebrities in the competition are ready to battle it out to get one step closer to the illusive Golden Mask Trophy and this week, the panelists will have an opportunity to ask some rapid-fire questions to each masked contestant.

episodes.name: Quarter Finals: Soundtrack of My Life Night
episodes.overview: It's "Soundtrack Of My Life Night!" The top five have come to play and open the show with a pitch-perfect performance of "More Than A Feeling." Then, the masks will be singing songs with a special meaning to them and we will get to hear from those closest to them.

episodes.name: The Semi-Finals: Head-To-Head Battles
episodes.overview: It's the Semi Finals on The Masked Singer and the final four are ready to make some hands clap with their superstar rendition of "HandClap!" The four semi-finalists are ready to battle it out ahead of next week's blockbuster season finale.

episodes.name: The Two-Hour Lucky Season 13 Finale
episodes.overview: In the grand culmination of Lucky Season 13, it is time for the final four to battle it out to be crowned the Season 13 Winner of The Masked Singer!

shows.name: The Night Agent
